exercises.instructionEn: UNIT 13 — Time Will Tell!
exercises.instructionUz: 13-UNIT — Vaqt ko'rsatadi!
exercises.explanationUz:
UNIT NOMINING MA'NOSI:
  'Time will tell!' — turg'un ibora.
  So'zma-so'z: 'Vaqt aytadi.'
  Ma'nosi: kelajakda nima bo'lishini hozir hech kim
  bilmaydi — buni faqat VAQT ko'rsatadi.

  DIQQAT: iborada 'WILL' bor — bu unitning
  asosiy grammatikasiga ishora.


UNIT 13 NING ASOSIY MAVZULARI
(4-modul muqovasidan):
  • future plans / intentions / predictions
    (kelajak rejalari / niyatlar / bashoratlar)
  • horoscopes
    (munajjimlar bashorati)


GRAMMATIKASI — UCh XIL KELAJAK:

  BE GOING TO   →  REJA va NIYAT
     'Jenny IS GOING TO stay at a fabulous hotel.'
     Bu bet aynan shu shaklga bag'ishlangan.

  WILL          →  TAXMIN
     'I think it will rain.'

  PRESENT CONTINUOUS →  REJALAShTIRILGAN uchrashuv
     'Jenny IS HAVING a party on 16th August.'
     (2-mashqda shu shakl so'raladi)


BETDAGI SARLAVHA RASMI:
  'FOR SALE' yozuvli uy — Jennining rejalaridan
  biri: uyini SOTISh (9-band).
  Bu rasm 4-modul muqovasida ham bor edi.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  fabulous     = ajoyib, zo'r
  to relax     = dam olmoq
  to windsurf  = vindserfing bilan shug'ullanmoq
  to sunbathe  = quyoshda toblanmoq
  ballet       = balet
  to join a gym = sport zaliga a'zo bo'lmoq
  a course     = kurs

exercises.instructionEn: Match the activities (1-10) to the pictures (A-J).
exercises.instructionUz: Mashg'ulotlarni (1-10) rasmlarga (A-J) moslang.
exercises.explanationUz:
O'N MAShG'ULOT:
   1  stay at a fabulous hotel  (ajoyib mehmonxonada
                                turmoq)
   2  relax                     (dam olmoq)
   3  start windsurfing         (vindserfingni
                                boshlamoq)
   4  sunbathe                  (quyoshda toblanmoq)
   5  take ballet lessons       (balet darslariga
                                bormoq)
   6  work at a cafe            (kafeda ishlamoq)
   7  start French lessons      (fransuz tili
                                darslarini boshlamoq)
   8  join a gym                (sport zaliga a'zo
                                bo'lmoq)
   9  sell her house            (uyini sotmoq)
  10  start a computer course   (kompyuter kursini
                                boshlamoq)


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

  A  →   9   sell her house
         (rasmda: 'FOR SALE' yozuvli uy)

  B  →   7   start French lessons
         (rasmda: sinf xonasi, doska oldida
          o'qituvchi, partalarda o'quvchilar)

  C  →  10   start a computer course
         (rasmda: kostyumdagi erkak va kompyuter
          monitori)

  D  →   2   relax
         (rasm 93-BETNING chap yuqorisida:
          gamakda yotib kitob o'qiyotgan ayol)

  E  →   5   take ballet lessons
         (rasmda: baletchi qiz stanok yonida,
          yonida o'qituvchi)

  F  →   3   start windsurfing
         (rasmda: dengizda vindserfing yelkani
          bilan qiz)

  G  →   1   stay at a fabulous hotel
         (rasmda: plyaj yonidagi katta mehmonxona)

  H  →   6   work at a cafe
         (rasmda: ofitsiant qiz podnosda ichimlik
          olib kelmoqda)

  I  →   4   sunbathe
         (rasmda: ko'zoynakli ayol dengiz bo'yida
          shezlongda yotibdi)

  J  →   8   join a gym
         (rasmda: sport zali, mashg'ulot
          uskunalari, odamlar)


DIQQAT — 'D' RASMI QAYERDA:
  'D' rasmi bu betda emas, 93-BETNING chap
  yuqorisida joylashgan — gamakda yotib kitob
  o'qiyotgan ayol.
  Bu aynan 'RELAX' (2-band): 93-betdagi xatda
  Jenni 'I'm going to RELAX as much as possible'
  deb yozgan.


'I' RASMI HAQIDA — NEGA 'SUNBATHE', 'RELAX' EMAS:
  Rasmda ayol DENGIZ BO'YIDA, quyosh ostida,
  ko'zoynak taqib yotibdi → bu aynan
  'to SUNBATHE' (quyoshda toblanmoq).
  'relax' esa umumiyroq — dam olishning har qanday
  turi.
  Kitob bu ikkisini ATAYLAB yonma-yon bergan,
  chunki ular o'xshash, lekin bir xil emas.


MAShG'ULOTLARNING IKKI GURUHI:

  TA'TIL bilan bog'liq (mehmonxonada):
     1 stay at a fabulous hotel
     2 relax
     3 start windsurfing
     4 sunbathe

  TA'TILDAN KEYIN (uyda, yoz davomida):
     5 take ballet lessons
     6 work at a cafe
     7 start French lessons
     8 join a gym
     9 sell her house
    10 start a computer course


DIQQAT — FE'L BIRIKMALARI:
  'STAY AT a hotel'      (predlog AT)
  'WORK AT a cafe'       (predlog AT)
  'START windsurfing'    (start + -ING)
  'START French lessons' (start + OT)
  'TAKE lessons'         (dars olmoq)
  'JOIN a gym'           (a'zo bo'lmoq)

exercises.instructionEn: Jenny sent a letter to her friend, Sarah. Listen to Sarah reading Jenny's letter and tick what Jenny is going to do and put a cross next to what she isn't going to do. Then, look at the list and make sentences, as in the examples.
exercises.instructionUz: Jenni do'sti Saraga xat yubordi. Sara Jennining xatini o'qiganini tinglang va Jenni QILMOQCHI bo'lgan ishlarga ✓, QILMOQCHI EMAS ishlarga ✗ qo'ying. So'ng ro'yxatga qarab namunalardagidek gaplar tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI IKKI NAMUNA:

  ✓ 1-band:
     'Jenny IS GOING TO stay at a fabulous hotel.'

  ✗ 4-band:
     'Jenny ISN'T GOING TO sunbathe.'


QOLIP — 'BE GOING TO':

  TASDIQ:
     ega + AM / IS / ARE + GOING TO + ASOSIY fe'l
     'Jenny IS GOING TO stay ...'

  INKOR:
     ega + ISN'T / AREN'T + GOING TO + ASOSIY fe'l
     'Jenny ISN'T GOING TO sunbathe.'
     DIQQAT: 'not' 'be' fe'lidan KEYIN qo'yiladi
     ('is not going to' → 'isn't going to').

  SO'ROQ:
     AM / IS / ARE + ega + GOING TO + ASOSIY fe'l?
     'IS Jenny GOING TO relax?'


DIQQAT — 'GOING TO' DAN KEYIN ASOSIY ShAKL:
     'going to STAY'      ✓
     'going to staying'   ✗
     'going to stays'     ✗
     'going to to stay'   ✗


DIQQAT — 'BE GOING TO' NIMANI BILDIRADI:
  Oldindan O'YLANGAN REJA yoki NIYAT.
  Jenni bu ishlarni allaqachon HAL QILGAN.

  'will' esa shu payt qabul qilingan qaror yoki
  taxmin uchun ishlatiladi.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR (93-betdagi xatdan tasdiqlangan):

   1  stay at a fabulous hotel   ✓  (kitob bergan)
   2  relax                      ✓
   3  start windsurfing          ✗
   4  sunbathe                   ✗  (kitob bergan)
   5  take ballet lessons        ✗
   6  work at a cafe             ✓
   7  start French lessons       ✗
   8  join a gym                 ✓
   9  sell her house             ✗
  10  start a computer course    ✓

  ✓ — BESHTA:  1, 2, 6, 8, 10
  ✗ — BESHTA:  3, 4, 5, 7, 9

QOIDA: xatda AYTILGAN ish → ✓, AYTILMAGAN → ✗.
Har birining asosi 93-betdagi 1b-javoblar
bo'limida ko'rsatilgan.

DIQQAT — 9-BAND ALDAMChI: unit sarlavhasida
'FOR SALE' yozuvli uy rasmi bor, lekin xatda uy
sotish haqida bir so'z ham yo'q — Jenni aksincha
MAShINA SOTIB OLMOQChI ('buy a new car').

exercises.instructionEn: Listen again and say what Jenny is doing on 1st June, 30th June and 16th August.
exercises.instructionUz: Yana tinglang va Jenni 1-iyun, 30-iyun va 16-avgustda nima qilishini ayting.
exercises.explanationUz:
BU MAShQ BOShQA GRAMMATIKANI SO'RAYDI:

  1b-mashqda:  BE GOING TO  (umumiy REJA)
  2-mashqda:   PRESENT CONTINUOUS
               (ANIQ SANAGA belgilangan ish)


QOIDA — QAChON PRESENT CONTINUOUS:
  Agar ish ANIQ VAQTGA belgilangan bo'lsa
  (kun, sana, soat) — PRESENT CONTINUOUS
  ishlatiladi:

     'Jenny IS LEAVING on 1st June.'
     'She IS COMING BACK on 30th June.'
     'She IS HAVING a party on 16th August.'

  Bu — 4-modul muqovasidagi
  'Present continuous (future meaning)'.


QOLIP:
  ega + am/is/are + fe'l-ING + ON + sana

  DIQQAT: SANA bilan 'ON' predlogi
  (3-modul testi, 90-bet, 3-mashqning qoidasi).


JAVOBLAR 93-BETDAGI XATDAN OLINADI:
  Jennining xati aynan shu uchta sanani
  eslatadi. Xat 93-betda to'liq bosilgan,
  shuning uchun audio SHART EMAS.

  Uch sana:
     1st June    — ta'tilning boshlanishi
     30th June   — ta'tilning tugashi
     16th August — tug'ilgan kun ziyofati
       (3-mashqning 4-savoli buni tasdiqlaydi:
        'When is Jenny having a party? Why?')


DIQQAT — 'BE GOING TO' va PRESENT CONTINUOUS
FARQI:

  'Jenny IS GOING TO relax.'
     → umumiy NIYAT, aniq vaqt yo'q

  'Jenny IS LEAVING on 1st June.'
     → ANIQ sanaga belgilangan, hamma narsa
       tayyor (chipta olingan)

  Ikkalasi ham KELAJAK haqida, lekin
  aniqlik darajasi boshqa.

exercises.instructionEn: Choose words from the list to fill in the gaps.
exercises.instructionUz: Bo'shliqlarni to'ldirish uchun ro'yxatdan so'zlarni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (8 ta so'z, 8 ta bo'shliq):
  computer, great, go, earn, work, join, lose,
  fabulous

Har biri AYNAN BIR MARTA ishlatiladi.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  GREAT news          (ajoyib yangilik)
  2  to GO on holiday    (ta'tilga bormoq)
  3  a FABULOUS hotel    (ajoyib mehmonxona)
  4  to WORK hard        (qattiq ishlamoq)
  5  to EARN money       (pul topmoq)
  6  to JOIN a gym       (sport zaliga a'zo bo'lmoq)
  7  to LOSE weight      (vazn tashlamoq)
  8  a COMPUTER course   (kompyuter kursi)


HAMMASI JENNINING XATIDAN:
  1  'I've got some GREAT NEWS.'
  2  'we are GOING ON HOLIDAY for a whole month'
  3  'a FABULOUS HOTEL right next to the beach'
  4  'after WORKING HARD all this year'
  5  'I want to EARN some extra MONEY'
  6  'I'm also going to JOIN A GYM'
  7  'to LOSE some WEIGHT'
  8  'I'm going to start a COMPUTER COURSE'


QANDAY ANIQLASh — SO'Z TURIGA QARANG:

  'TO' bor (2, 4, 5, 6, 7) → FE'L kerak:
     go, work, earn, join, lose

  'A' bor (3, 8) → OT yoki SIFAT kerak:
     a FABULOUS hotel (sifat)
     a COMPUTER course (ot, sifat vazifasida)

  Artiklsiz (1) → SIFAT:
     GREAT news
     ('news' SANALMAYDIGAN → 'a' YO'Q)


ENG MUHIM BIRIKMALAR — YODLASh KERAK:

  to EARN money   =  pul topmoq (mehnat bilan)
     DIQQAT: 'to WIN money' — yutuqda, sovrinda.
             'to earn' — ishlab topish.

  to LOSE weight  =  vazn tashlamoq
     Aksi: 'to PUT ON weight' (vazn olmoq).
     DIQQAT: 'to lose' — yo'qotmoq.

  to JOIN a gym   =  sport zaliga A'ZO BO'LMOQ
     DIQQAT: 'to go to a gym' — shunchaki bormoq.

  to WORK hard    =  qattiq ishlamoq
     DIQQAT: 'hardly' — BUTUNLAY boshqa so'z
     ('deyarli emas')! 'work hardly' XATO.

  to GO on holiday =  ta'tilga bormoq
     Predlog ON.


DIQQAT — 1 va 3-BANDLAR IKKALASI HAM 'AJOYIB':
     GREAT news      — 'great' = ajoyib, zo'r
     FABULOUS hotel  — 'fabulous' = ajoyib, zo'r
  Ma'nolari yaqin, lekin kitob har birini AYNAN
  xatdagi joyida ishlatishni so'raydi.

tasks.answer: great
tasks.whyUz:
'GREAT news' = ajoyib yangilik.
Xatning birinchi jumlasi:
'I've got some GREAT NEWS.'
DIQQAT: 'news' SANALMAYDIGAN ot → 'a' YO'Q.

tasks.answer: go
tasks.whyUz:
'to GO ON holiday' = ta'tilga bormoq.
'TO' bor → FE'L kerak.
Xatda: 'we are GOING ON HOLIDAY for a whole
month'.
Predlog ON.

tasks.answer: fabulous
tasks.whyUz:
'a FABULOUS hotel' = ajoyib mehmonxona.
'A' va ot orasida → SIFAT kerak.
Xatda: 'a FABULOUS HOTEL right next to the
beach'.
92-betdagi 1-band ham shu.

tasks.answer: work
tasks.whyUz:
'to WORK HARD' = qattiq ishlamoq.
Xatda: 'after WORKING HARD all this year'.
DIQQAT: 'hard' (qattiq) va 'hardly'
(deyarli emas) — BUTUNLAY boshqa so'zlar!
'work hardly' XATO.

tasks.answer: earn
tasks.whyUz:
'to EARN money' = pul topmoq (mehnat bilan).
Xatda: 'I want to EARN some extra MONEY'.
DIQQAT: 'to WIN money' — yutuq, sovrin uchun.
'to earn' — ishlab topish.

tasks.answer: join
tasks.whyUz:
'to JOIN a gym' = sport zaliga A'ZO BO'LMOQ.
Xatda: 'I'm also going to JOIN A GYM'.
DIQQAT: 'to go to a gym' — shunchaki bormoq;
'to join' — a'zolik ochish.

tasks.answer: lose
tasks.whyUz:
'to LOSE weight' = vazn tashlamoq.
Xatda: 'to LOSE some WEIGHT'.
Aksi: 'to PUT ON weight' (vazn olmoq).
lose → LOST (noto'g'ri fe'l).

tasks.answer: computer
tasks.whyUz:
'a COMPUTER course' = kompyuter kursi.
Xatda: 'I'm going to start a COMPUTER COURSE'.
DIQQAT: 'computer' — OT, lekin bu yerda SIFAT
vazifasini bajaradi (ot + ot birikmasi).
Birinchi ot KO'PLIK BO'LMAYDI
('computers course' XATO).

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures and match them to the prompts below.
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmlarga qarang va ularni quyidagi ko'rsatmalarga moslang.
exercises.explanationUz:
OLTI KO'RSATMA:
  • pick some flowers        (gul termoq)
  • have a picnic in the park (parkda piknik
                               qilmoq)
  • fix his car              (mashinasini
                              tuzatmoq)
  • play football            (futbol o'ynamoq)
  • make some fresh orange juice
                             (yangi apelsin
                              sharbati tayyorlamoq)
  • take some photographs    (surat olmoq)


OLTI RASM:
  A  Oq gullar orasidagi ayol
  B  Kapoti ochiq mashina, yonida erkak
  C  Fotoapparatli ayol, orqada qadimiy ustunlar
  D  Keksa er-xotin, it va savat bilan maysazorda
  E  Bola, qo'lini TO'PGA qo'yib o'tiribdi
  F  Bozor/do'konda meva ushlab turgan ayol


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  A  →  pick some flowers          (NAMUNA)
  B  →  fix his car
  C  →  take some photographs
  D  →  have a picnic in the park
  E  →  play football
  F  →  make some fresh orange juice


QANDAY ANIQLANADI:

  A  Ayol gullar orasida turibdi → GUL TERMOQ.
     Kitob buni namuna qilib bergan.

  B  Mashinaning KAPOTI OChIQ va erkak unga
     engashgan → MAShINANI TUZATMOQ.

  C  Ayolning qo'lida FOTOAPPARAT, orqada
     tarixiy ustunlar → SURAT OLMOQ.

  D  Keksa er-xotin maysazorda, ayolning qo'lida
     SAVAT, yonida it → PARKDA PIKNIK.

  E  Bola qo'lini oq-qora TO'PGA qo'yib o'tiribdi
     → FUTBOL O'YNAMOQ.

  F  Ayol bozorda/do'konda meva ushlab turibdi →
     APELSIN ShARBATI tayyorlamoq.


DIQQAT — 'FIX' va 'MAKE':
  'FIX a car'  = mashinani TUZATMOQ (buzilganini)
  'MAKE juice' = sharbat TAYYORLAMOQ (yangidan)
  Ikkalasi ham o'zbekchada 'qilmoq' bo'lishi
  mumkin, lekin ingliz tilida BOShQA fe'llar.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to pick flowers = gul termoq
  a picnic        = piknik
  to fix          = tuzatmoq
  fresh           = yangi, tetik
  a photograph    = surat (= a photo)

tasks.right: have a picnic in the park

  C  She's going to take some photographs.
  D  They're going to have a picnic in the park.
  E  He's going to play football.

  A  U gul termoqchi.

  Rasmda odamlar ishni BOShLAMAGAN — ular

  PRESENT CONTINUOUS bo'lardi:

exercises.instructionEn: What are they going to do? Match column A to column B.
exercises.instructionUz: Ular nima qilishmoqchi? A ustunni B ustunga moslang.
exercises.explanationUz:
USTUN A (holat / xohish):
  1  Joe doesn't like working at the cafe
  2  Richard needs to lose weight
  3  Sally wants to pass her exams
  4  David has got a new job in Paris
  5  Tina wants a nice suntan
  6  Lucy likes dancing

USTUN B (harakat):
  a  study really hard
  b  sunbathe in the garden
  c  take ballet lessons
  d  find another job
  e  start French lessons
  f  join a gym


Kitob BIRINChISINI chizib bergan: 1 → d


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  →  d   find another job
  2  →  f   join a gym
  3  →  a   study really hard
  4  →  e   start French lessons
  5  →  b   sunbathe in the garden
  6  →  c   take ballet lessons


QANDAY ANIQLANADI — SABAB → HARAKAT:

  1  Kafedagi ish yoqmaydi → BOShQA ISh topish
  2  Vazn tashlash kerak → SPORT ZALIGA a'zo
     bo'lish
  3  Imtihonlardan o'tmoqchi → QATTIQ O'QISh
  4  PARIJDA yangi ish → FRANSUZ TILI darslari
     (Parij — Fransiya poytaxti)
  5  Chiroyli QORAYISh xohlaydi → QUYOShDA
     TOBLANISh
  6  Raqsni yaxshi ko'radi → BALET darslari


ENG OSON BAND — 4:
  'a new job in PARIS' va 'start FRENCH lessons'
  — Parij Fransiyada, demak fransuz tili kerak.
  ANIQ bog'liqlik. Shu banddan boshlang.


DIQQAT — 2 va 6-BANDLAR ALDAMChI EMAS:
  'join a gym' vazn tashlash uchun (2),
  'take ballet lessons' raqs uchun (6).
  Balet ham sport, lekin 6-bandda 'likes DANCING'
  aniq aytilgan.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to lose weight = vazn tashlamoq
  to pass exams  = imtihonlardan o'tmoq
  a suntan       = quyoshda qorayish
  to sunbathe    = quyoshda toblanmoq
  ballet         = balet
  another        = boshqa (yana bitta)

exercises.instructionEn: Then make sentences using so.
exercises.instructionUz: So'ng 'so' dan foydalanib gaplar tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'Joe doesn't like working at the cafe, SO HE IS
   GOING TO find another job.'


QOLIP:
  [SABAB], SO + ega + IS GOING TO + ASOSIY fe'l.

  DIQQAT: 'so' dan OLDIN VERGUL.
  'so' — NATIJA bog'lovchisi
  (Coursebook 95-bet, Grammar 57-bet).


BARCHA OLTI GAP:

  1  Joe doesn't like working at the cafe, so he
     is going to find another job.       (NAMUNA)

  2  Richard needs to lose weight, so he is going
     to join a gym.

  3  Sally wants to pass her exams, so she is
     going to study really hard.

  4  David has got a new job in Paris, so he is
     going to start French lessons.

  5  Tina wants a nice suntan, so she is going to
     sunbathe in the garden.

  6  Lucy likes dancing, so she is going to take
     ballet lessons.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  1  Joga kafedagi ish yoqmaydi, shuning uchun u
     boshqa ish topmoqchi.
  2  Richardga vazn tashlash kerak, shuning uchun
     u sport zaliga a'zo bo'lmoqchi.
  3  Salli imtihonlardan o'tmoqchi, shuning uchun
     u juda qattiq o'qimoqchi.
  4  Devidning Parijda yangi ishi bor, shuning
     uchun u fransuz tili darslarini boshlamoqchi.
  5  Tina chiroyli qoraymoqchi, shuning uchun u
     bog'da quyoshda toblanmoqchi.
  6  Lyusi raqsni yaxshi ko'radi, shuning uchun u
     balet darslariga bormoqchi.


OLMOShLAR:
  Joe, Richard, David  →  HE  is going to
  Sally, Tina, Lucy    →  SHE is going to

  Hammasi BIRLIK → 'IS going to'.


ESLATMA — 'BECAUSE' BILAN HAM AYTISh MUMKIN:
  'Joe is going to find another job BECAUSE he
   doesn't like working at the cafe.'
  Ma'no BIR XIL, faqat TARTIB teskari.

  Lekin kitob 'SO' ni so'ragan → SABAB birinchi,
  NATIJA ikkinchi.

  Grammar 59-betdagi 8-mashq bilan AYNAN bir xil
  tuzilish.

exercises.instructionEn: Match the prompts to the pictures. Then, say what the astrologist told Andy and Mary, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Ko'rsatmalarni rasmlarga moslang. So'ng munajjim Endi va Meriga nima deganini ayting, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
OLTI KO'RSATMA:
  • go on a long journey        (uzoq safarga
                                 chiqmoq)
  • receive an invitation       (taklif olmoq)
  • argue with your best friend (eng yaqin do'st
                                 bilan janjallashmoq)
  • have problems with your health
                                (sog'liq muammosi)
  • have problems with your car (mashina muammosi)
  • celebrate something special (biror maxsus
                                 voqeani nishonlamoq)


RASMLAR:

  ANDY ustuni:
     1  Ikki erkak peshonama-peshona turib
        janjallashyapti
     2  Kapoti ochiq mashina, unga engashgan erkak
        + jarima yozayotgan yo'l nazoratchisi

  MARY ustuni:
     1  Stetoskopli shifokor ayolni ko'rikdan
        o'tkazyapti
     2  Ikki qadah bir-biriga urilmoqda
     3  Ochiq chamadon, ichida narsalar joylangan


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

  ANDY:
     • argue with your best friend
       (ikki erkak janjallashyapti)
     • have problems with your car
       (mashina + jarima)

  MARY:
     • have problems with your health
       (shifokor ko'rigi)
     • celebrate something special
       (qadahlar urilmoqda)
     • go on a long journey
       (joylangan chamadon)


⚠ HALOL OGOHLANTIRISh:
  Oltinchi ko'rsatma — 'RECEIVE AN INVITATION' —
  ga mos rasm bizdagi skanda TOPILMADI.

  Andyning pastki ikki tasviri (mashina va
  nazoratchi) BIRGALIKDA bitta ma'noni beradi:
  mashina buzildi va jarima yozildi →
  'have problems with your car'.
  Nazoratchi ALOHIDA ko'rsatma emas — u pochtachi
  yoki taklif keltiruvchi emas (kepkasida nishon,
  yelkasida tasma, qo'lida jarima daftari).

  Shuning uchun bu bandni taxmin bilan
  to'ldirmadim.


KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'Andy, you WILL ARGUE with your best friend.
   You will also ...'


QOLIP:
  [Ism], you WILL + ASOSIY fe'l + ... .
  You will ALSO + ASOSIY fe'l + ... .

  DIQQAT: munajjim bashorat qilyapti → 'WILL'
  (Coursebook 95-bet: bashorat uchun 'will').
  Coursebook 96-betdagi 12 bashorat ham hammasi
  'will' bilan edi.


TO'LIQ GAPLAR:

  ANDY:
     'Andy, you will argue with your best friend.
      You will also have problems with your car.'

  MARY:
     'Mary, you will have problems with your
      health. You will also celebrate something
      special and go on a long journey.'


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  Endi, sen eng yaqin do'sting bilan
  janjallashasan. Shuningdek, mashinang bilan
  muammoing bo'ladi.

  Meri, sening sog'lig'ingda muammo bo'ladi.
  Shuningdek, biror maxsus voqeani nishonlaysan
  va uzoq safarga chiqasan.


DIQQAT — 'ALSO' NING O'RNI:
  'You will ALSO have problems ...'
  'also' — 'will' dan KEYIN, asosiy fe'ldan
  OLDIN.
  'You also will ...' — kamroq tabiiy.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  an astrologist  = munajjim
  to receive      = olmoq
  to argue with   = ... bilan janjallashmoq
  to celebrate    = nishonlamoq
  a journey       = safar (uzoq)

exercises.instructionEn: Read Jenny's letter and answer the questions.
exercises.instructionUz: Jennining xatini o'qing va savollarga javob bering.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'RT SAVOL. Jennining XATI 93-BETDA
bosilgan — javoblar o'sha yerdan olinadi.

SAVOLLAR:

  1  Where is Jenny going to spend her summer
     holiday?
     (Jenni yozgi ta'tilini qayerda o'tkazmoqchi?)

  2  What is Jenny going to do during her holiday?
     (Jenni ta'til davomida nima qilmoqchi?)

  3  What are Jenny's plans for the rest of the
     summer?
     (Jennining yozning qolgan qismiga rejalari
      qanday?)

  4  When is Jenny having a party? Why?
     (Jenni qachon ziyofat qiladi? Nega?)


SAVOLLARNING TUZILIShI — DIQQAT:

  1, 2-savollar:  'is going to' →
                  javob ham 'is going to' bilan
  3-savol:        'plans' →
                  javob rejalar ro'yxati
  4-savol:        'is having' → PRESENT CONTINUOUS
                  (aniq sanaga belgilangan)


JAVOB QOLIPLARI:

  1  'She is going to spend her summer holiday
      in/at ... .'

  2  'She is going to ... and ... .'
     (1b-mashqdagi ✓ belgilangan bandlar)

  3  'She is going to ... .'
     (ta'tildan keyingi rejalar: 5-10 bandlar)

  4  'She is having a party on 16th August
      because ... .'
     'because' bilan SABAB ko'rsatiladi.


DIQQAT — SAVOLDAGI ZAMONNI JAVOBDA SAQLANG:
  Savol: 'What IS Jenny GOING TO do ...?'
  Javob: 'She IS GOING TO ...'

  Savol: 'When IS Jenny HAVING a party?'
  Javob: 'She IS HAVING a party on ...'


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to spend a holiday = ta'tilni o'tkazmoq
  during             = ... davomida
  the rest of        = ... ning qolgan qismi
  to have a party    = ziyofat qilmoq

exercises.instructionEn: Jenny's letter to Sarah
exercises.instructionUz: Jennining Saraga yozgan xati
exercises.explanationUz:
XATNING TO'LIQ MATNI:

                              6 Greenway Road
                              Wethersham
                              6 May, ...

  Dear Sarah,

  I've got some great news. Richard and I are going
  on holiday for a whole month. Guess where —
  Hawaii!

  We're leaving on 1st June. We both love swimming,
  so we're going to stay at a fabulous hotel right
  next to the beach. I'm going to relax as much as
  possible because I'm quite tired after working
  hard all this year.

  We're coming back from our holidays on 30th June,
  and I've got lots of plans for the rest of the
  summer. First, I'm going to work at a cafe
  because I want to earn some extra money and buy a
  new car. I'm also going to join a gym to lose
  some weight. Finally, I want to find a better job
  in autumn, so I'm going to start a computer
  course.

  Oh, I nearly forgot! On 16th August we're having
  a garden party to celebrate Richard's birthday.
  Please try to come. You're welcome to spend the
  night here.

  Well, that's all for now. Hope to see you soon.

                              Love,
                              Jenny


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:

                              6 Grinvey ko'chasi
                              Vetersham
                              6-may, ...

  Hurmatli Sara,

  Menda ajoyib yangilik bor. Richard bilan men
  butun bir oyga ta'tilga ketyapmiz. Qayerga
  ekanini top-chi — Gavayiga!

  Biz 1-iyunda jo'naymiz. Ikkalamiz ham suzishni
  yaxshi ko'ramiz, shuning uchun plyajning
  yonginasidagi ajoyib mehmonxonada turmoqchimiz.
  Men imkon qadar ko'proq dam olmoqchiman, chunki
  butun yil qattiq ishlaganimdan keyin ancha
  charchaganman.

  Biz ta'tildan 30-iyunda qaytamiz va yozning
  qolgan qismiga ko'plab rejalarim bor. Avvalo,
  kafeda ishlamoqchiman, chunki bir oz qo'shimcha
  pul topib, yangi mashina sotib olmoqchiman.
  Shuningdek, biroz vazn tashlash uchun sport
  zaliga a'zo bo'lmoqchiman. Nihoyat, kuzda
  yaxshiroq ish topmoqchiman, shuning uchun
  kompyuter kursini boshlamoqchiman.

  Voy, sal bo'lmasa unutayozdim! 16-avgustda
  Richardning tug'ilgan kunini nishonlash uchun
  bog'da ziyofat qilamiz. Iltimos, kelishga
  harakat qil. Kechasi shu yerda qolsang ham
  mayli.

  Xo'sh, hozircha shu. Tez orada ko'rishguncha.

                              Mehr bilan,
                              Jenni


XAT QOLIPI (rasmiy bo'lmagan xat):
  O'ng yuqorida:  MANZIL va SANA
  Boshi:          'Dear Sarah,'
  Oxiri:          'Love, Jenny'
  DIQQAT: 'Love,' — yaqin do'stga yoziladi.


XATDAGI IKKI XIL KELAJAK — ENG MUHIM:

  BE GOING TO  →  REJA va NIYAT
     'we're GOING TO stay at a fabulous hotel'
     'I'm GOING TO relax'
     'I'm GOING TO work at a cafe'
     'I'm GOING TO join a gym'
     'I'm GOING TO start a computer course'

  PRESENT CONTINUOUS  →  QAT'IY BELGILANGAN reja
     'We're LEAVING on 1st June.'
     'We're COMING BACK ... on 30th June.'
     'On 16th August we're HAVING a garden party.'

  NAQSh: PRESENT CONTINUOUS ishlatilgan uchala
  gapda ham ANIQ SANA bor!
  'be going to' li gaplarda esa sana YO'Q.
  Bu — 93-betdagi grammatika qutisining
  aynan qoidasi.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a whole month  = butun bir oy
  Guess where!   = Qayerda ekanini top-chi!
  Hawaii         = Gavayi (AQSh shtati, orollar)
  right next to  = yonginasida
  as much as possible = imkon qadar ko'proq
  extra money    = qo'shimcha pul
  to lose weight = vazn tashlamoq
  autumn         = kuz
  I nearly forgot = sal bo'lmasa unutayozdim
  a garden party = bog'dagi ziyofat
  to celebrate   = nishonlamoq
  You're welcome to ... = ... bo'lsangiz mayli
  to spend the night = tunab qolmoq
  that's all for now = hozircha shu

tasks.uz: 6 Grinvey ko'chasi, Vetersham. 6-may, ...
tasks.note:
Rasmiy bo'lmagan xatda MANZIL va SANA
o'ng YUQORIDA yoziladi.
Manzil: uy raqami → ko'cha → shahar.

tasks.en: Dear Sarah,
tasks.uz: Hurmatli Sara,
tasks.note:
Xat boshi. Ismdan keyin VERGUL.
Keyingi qator yangi xatboshidan boshlanadi.

tasks.en: I've got some great news. Richard and I are going on holiday for a whole month. Guess where — Hawaii!
tasks.uz: Menda ajoyib yangilik bor. Richard bilan men butun bir oyga ta'tilga ketyapmiz. Qayerga ekanini top-chi — Gavayiga!
tasks.note:
'news' — SANALMAYDIGAN ot ('a news' XATO).
'Richard AND I' — 'I' oxirida turadi.
'go ON holiday' — predlog ON.
'a whole month' = butun bir oy.
4-mashqning 1-bandi shu yerdan: 'GREAT news'.

tasks.en: We're leaving on 1st June.
tasks.uz: Biz 1-iyunda jo'naymiz.
tasks.note:
PRESENT CONTINUOUS + ANIQ SANA →
QAT'IY BELGILANGAN reja (chipta olingan).
2-mashqning birinchi sanasi.

tasks.en: We both love swimming, so we're going to stay at a fabulous hotel right next to the beach.
tasks.uz: Ikkalamiz ham suzishni yaxshi ko'ramiz, shuning uchun plyajning yonginasidagi ajoyib mehmonxonada turmoqchimiz.
tasks.note:
'BE GOING TO' — REJA (aniq sana yo'q).
'so' — NATIJA bog'lovchisi.
'love SWIMMING' — 'love' dan keyin '-ing'.
'RIGHT next to' — 'right' kuchaytiradi:
'yonginasida'.
92-betdagi 1-band ✓ va 4-mashqning 3-bandi
('a FABULOUS hotel') shu yerdan.

tasks.en: I'm going to relax as much as possible because I'm quite tired after working hard all this year.
tasks.uz: Men imkon qadar ko'proq dam olmoqchiman, chunki butun yil qattiq ishlaganimdan keyin ancha charchaganman.
tasks.note:
'BE GOING TO' — REJA.
'because' — SABAB.
'as much as possible' = imkon qadar ko'proq.
'after WORKING' — predlogdan keyin '-ing'.
92-betdagi 2-band ✓ (relax) shu yerdan;
4-mashqning 4-bandi ('to WORK hard') ham.

tasks.en: We're coming back from our holidays on 30th June, and I've got lots of plans for the rest of the summer.
tasks.uz: Biz ta'tildan 30-iyunda qaytamiz va yozning qolgan qismiga ko'plab rejalarim bor.
tasks.note:
PRESENT CONTINUOUS + ANIQ SANA →
QAT'IY BELGILANGAN reja.
2-mashqning ikkinchi sanasi.
'the rest of the summer' = yozning qolgan qismi.

tasks.en: First, I'm going to work at a cafe because I want to earn some extra money and buy a new car.
tasks.uz: Avvalo, kafeda ishlamoqchiman, chunki bir oz qo'shimcha pul topib, yangi mashina sotib olmoqchiman.
tasks.note:
'BE GOING TO' — REJA.
'work AT a cafe' — predlog AT.
'to EARN money' = pul topmoq
('to win money' XATO — u yutuq uchun).
92-betdagi 6-band ✓; 4-mashqning 5-bandi.

tasks.en: I'm also going to join a gym to lose some weight.
tasks.uz: Shuningdek, biroz vazn tashlash uchun sport zaliga a'zo bo'lmoqchiman.
tasks.note:
'BE GOING TO' — REJA.
'TO LOSE' — MAQSAD ('nima uchun?').
'lose weight' = vazn tashlamoq.
92-betdagi 8-band ✓; 4-mashqning 6 va 7-bandlari.

tasks.en: Finally, I want to find a better job in autumn, so I'm going to start a computer course.
tasks.uz: Nihoyat, kuzda yaxshiroq ish topmoqchiman, shuning uchun kompyuter kursini boshlamoqchiman.
tasks.note:
'BE GOING TO' — REJA.
'a BETTER job' — QIYOSIY daraja (Unit 12).
'IN autumn' — fasl bilan predlog IN.
92-betdagi 10-band ✓; 4-mashqning 8-bandi.

tasks.en: Oh, I nearly forgot! On 16th August we're having a garden party to celebrate Richard's birthday.
tasks.uz: Voy, sal bo'lmasa unutayozdim! 16-avgustda Richardning tug'ilgan kunini nishonlash uchun bog'da ziyofat qilamiz.
tasks.note:
PRESENT CONTINUOUS + ANIQ SANA →
QAT'IY BELGILANGAN reja.
2-mashqning uchinchi sanasi.
'nearly' = sal bo'lmasa (88-betdagi epizodda ham).
'TO CELEBRATE' — MAQSAD.

tasks.en: Please try to come. You're welcome to spend the night here.
tasks.uz: Iltimos, kelishga harakat qil. Kechasi shu yerda qolsang ham mayli.
tasks.note:
'try TO come' = kelishga harakat qilmoq.
'You're welcome to ...' = ... bo'lsangiz mayli
(taklif qilishning muloyim shakli).
'spend the night' = tunab qolmoq.

tasks.en: Well, that's all for now. Hope to see you soon. Love, Jenny
tasks.uz: Xo'sh, hozircha shu. Tez orada ko'rishguncha. Mehr bilan, Jenni.
tasks.note:
Xatning TUGALLANMASI.
'that's all for now' = hozircha shu.
'Hope to see you soon' — 'I' tushirib
qoldirilgan (norasmiy xatda mumkin).
'Love,' — yaqin do'st yoki qarindoshga.

exercises.instructionEn: Answers to Ex. 1b (page 92): tick / cross
exercises.instructionUz: 92-betdagi 1b-mashqning javoblari: ✓ / ✗
exercises.explanationUz:
92-BETDAGI 1b-MAShQNING TO'LIQ JAVOBI —
XATDAN ANIQLANDI (audio KERAK EMAS).

   1  stay at a fabulous hotel   ✓  (kitob bergan)
   2  relax                      ✓
   3  start windsurfing          ✗
   4  sunbathe                   ✗  (kitob bergan)
   5  take ballet lessons        ✗
   6  work at a cafe             ✓
   7  start French lessons       ✗
   8  join a gym                 ✓
   9  sell her house             ✗
  10  start a computer course    ✓

  ✓ — BESHTA:  1, 2, 6, 8, 10
  ✗ — BESHTA:  3, 4, 5, 7, 9


QOIDA — QANDAY ANIQLANDI:
  Xatda AYTILGAN ish → ✓
  Xatda AYTILMAGAN ish → ✗

  Kitob 4-bandni ('sunbathe') ✗ bilan bergan —
  bu qoidani TASDIQLAYDI: xatda 'sunbathe'
  so'zi umuman yo'q.


HAR BIR ✗ NEGA:
   3  windsurfing — xatda umuman eslatilmagan
      (faqat 'swimming' bor)
   4  sunbathe    — xatda yo'q (kitob bergan)
   5  ballet      — xatda yo'q
   7  French      — xatda yo'q
      (faqat KOMPYUTER kursi bor)
   9  sell her house — xatda yo'q
      (aksincha, u MAShINA SOTIB OLMOQChI)


DIQQAT — 9-BAND ALDAMChI:
  Unit sarlavhasida 'FOR SALE' yozuvli uy rasmi
  bor va 1a-mashqda 'sell her house' bandi bor.
  LEKIN xatda uy sotish haqida BIR SO'Z ham yo'q —
  Jenni MAShINA SOTIB OLMOQChI ('buy a new car').
  Rasm shunchaki mashg'ulotni ko'rsatadi,
  Jennining rejasi emas.


GAPLAR (namunadagidek):

     Jenny is going to stay at a fabulous hotel.
     Jenny is going to relax.
     Jenny is going to work at a cafe.

     Jenny isn't going to sunbathe.
     Jenny isn't going to take ballet lessons.
     Jenny isn't going to start French lessons.
     Jenny isn't going to sell her house.

exercises.instructionEn: Answers to Ex. 2 (page 92): what Jenny is doing on 1st June, 30th June and 16th August
exercises.instructionUz: 92-betdagi 2-mashqning javoblari: Jenni 1-iyun, 30-iyun va 16-avgustda nima qiladi
exercises.explanationUz:
UCh SANA — HAMMASI XATDAN.

  1st JUNE:
     'We're LEAVING on 1st June.'
     → Jenny is leaving (for Hawaii) on 1st June.
     (Jenni 1-iyunda Gavayiga jo'nab ketadi.)

  30th JUNE:
     'We're COMING BACK from our holidays on 30th
      June.'
     → Jenny is coming back from her holidays on
       30th June.
     (Jenni 30-iyunda ta'tildan qaytadi.)

  16th AUGUST:
     'On 16th August we're HAVING a garden party to
      celebrate Richard's birthday.'
     → Jenny is having a garden party on 16th
       August (to celebrate Richard's birthday).
     (Jenni 16-avgustda Richardning tug'ilgan
      kunini nishonlash uchun bog'da ziyofat
      qiladi.)


ENG MUHIM KUZATUV:
  Xatda PRESENT CONTINUOUS aynan SHU UChTA gapda
  ishlatilgan — va uchalasida ham ANIQ SANA bor!

  Qolgan hamma rejalar 'BE GOING TO' bilan
  berilgan va ularda SANA YO'Q.

  Bu — 93-betdagi grammatika qutisining qoidasi:
     'be going to'        →  reja va niyat
     'present continuous' →  QAT'IY BELGILANGAN
                             reja (fixed arrangement)


NEGA BU FARQ MUHIM:
  Chipta olingan, joy band qilingan, sana
  belgilangan → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
  Faqat niyat qilingan, hali aniq emas →
  BE GOING TO.

  Jennining ta'tili ANIQ (chipta bor) → 'we're
  leaving'.
  Kafedagi ish esa hali REJA → 'I'm going to
  work'.

tasks.en: Answers to Ex. 2 (page 92): what Jenny is doing on 1st June, 30th June and 16th August
tasks.uz: 92-betdagi 2-mashqning javoblari: Jenni 1-iyun, 30-iyun va 16-avgustda nima qiladi

tasks.en: 1st June — Jenny is leaving (for Hawaii).
tasks.uz: 1-iyun — Jenni (Gavayiga) jo'nab ketadi.
tasks.note:
Xatda: 'We're LEAVING on 1st June.'
PRESENT CONTINUOUS + ANIQ SANA.

tasks.en: 30th June — Jenny is coming back from her holidays.
tasks.uz: 30-iyun — Jenni ta'tildan qaytadi.
tasks.note:
Xatda: 'We're COMING BACK from our holidays on
30th June.'
'come back FROM' — predlog FROM.

tasks.en: 16th August — Jenny is having a garden party to celebrate Richard's birthday.
tasks.uz: 16-avgust — Jenni Richardning tug'ilgan kunini nishonlash uchun bog'da ziyofat qiladi.
tasks.note:
Xatda: 'On 16th August we're HAVING a garden
party TO CELEBRATE Richard's birthday.'
'to celebrate' — MAQSAD.

tasks.en: All three use the present continuous — and all three have a fixed date.
tasks.uz: Uchalasida ham present continuous ishlatilgan — va uchalasida ham aniq sana bor.
tasks.note:
Xatdagi qolgan rejalar 'be going to' bilan
berilgan va ularda SANA YO'Q.
Bu — grammatika qutisining aynan qoidasi.

exercises.instructionEn: Read Jenny's letter and answer the questions. (answers)
exercises.instructionUz: Jennining xatini o'qing va savollarga javob bering. (javoblar)
exercises.explanationUz: 92-BETDAGI 3-MAShQNING TO'LIQ JAVOBLARI.

tasks.en: Read Jenny's letter and answer the questions. (answers)
tasks.uz: Jennining xatini o'qing va savollarga javob bering. (javoblar)

tasks.en: 1  Where is Jenny going to spend her summer holiday?
tasks.uz: 1  Jenni yozgi ta'tilini qayerda o'tkazmoqchi?
tasks.note: SAVOL.

tasks.en: She is going to spend it in Hawaii. She and Richard are going to stay at a fabulous hotel right next to the beach.
tasks.uz: U ta'tilini Gavayida o'tkazmoqchi. U Richard bilan plyajning yonginasidagi ajoyib mehmonxonada turmoqchi.
tasks.note:
JAVOB.
Xatda: 'Guess where — HAWAII!' va
'we're going to stay at a FABULOUS HOTEL right
next to the beach.'
Gavayi — Tinch okeandagi AQSh shtati.

tasks.en: 2  What is Jenny going to do during her holiday?
tasks.uz: 2  Jenni ta'til davomida nima qilmoqchi?
tasks.note: SAVOL.

tasks.en: She is going to relax as much as possible, because she is quite tired after working hard all this year. She and Richard both love swimming.
tasks.uz: U imkon qadar ko'proq dam olmoqchi, chunki butun yil qattiq ishlaganidan keyin ancha charchagan. U va Richard ikkalasi ham suzishni yaxshi ko'radi.
tasks.note:
JAVOB.
TA'TIL davridagi rejalar: 1-band (mehmonxona)
va 2-band (relax).
'because' bilan SABAB ko'rsatilgan.

tasks.en: 3  What are Jenny's plans for the rest of the summer?
tasks.uz: 3  Jennining yozning qolgan qismiga rejalari qanday?
tasks.note:
SAVOL.
Ta'tildan KEYINGI rejalar.

tasks.en: She is going to work at a cafe to earn some extra money and buy a new car. She is also going to join a gym to lose some weight. Finally, she is going to start a computer course because she wants to find a better job in autumn.
tasks.uz: U qo'shimcha pul topib, yangi mashina sotib olish uchun kafeda ishlamoqchi. Shuningdek, biroz vazn tashlash uchun sport zaliga a'zo bo'lmoqchi. Nihoyat, kuzda yaxshiroq ish topmoqchi bo'lgani uchun kompyuter kursini boshlamoqchi.
tasks.note:
JAVOB.
UCH reja: 6, 8, 10-bandlar.
Xatda 'First ... also ... Finally ...' bilan
tartiblangan.

tasks.en: 4  When is Jenny having a party? Why?
tasks.uz: 4  Jenni qachon ziyofat qiladi? Nega?
tasks.note:
SAVOL.
PRESENT CONTINUOUS — aniq sanaga belgilangan.

tasks.en: She is having a garden party on 16th August to celebrate Richard's birthday.
tasks.uz: U 16-avgustda Richardning tug'ilgan kunini nishonlash uchun bog'da ziyofat qiladi.
tasks.note:
JAVOB.
'When?' → 16th August.
'Why?' → to celebrate Richard's birthday.
MAQSAD 'to + fe'l' bilan berilgan.

exercises.instructionEn: The twelve star signs and their horoscopes
exercises.instructionUz: O'n ikki burj va ularning bashoratlari
exercises.explanationUz:
O'N IKKI BURJ (star signs) VA SANALARI:

  Aries       (Mar. 21 - Apr. 19)  — Qo'y
  Taurus      (Apr. 20 - May 21)   — Buzoq
  Gemini      (May 22 - June 21)   — Egizaklar
  Cancer      (June 22 - July 22)  — Qisqichbaqa
  Leo         (July 23 - Aug. 23)  — Arslon
  Virgo       (Aug. 24 - Sept. 23) — Parizod
  Libra       (Sept. 24 - Oct. 23) — Tarozi
  Scorpio     (Oct. 24 - Nov. 22)  — Chayon
  Sagittarius (Nov. 23 - Dec. 21)  — Yoy
  Capricorn   (Dec. 22 - Jan. 20)  — Echki
  Aquarius    (Jan. 21 - Feb. 18)  — Qovga
  Pisces      (Feb. 19 - Mar. 20)  — Baliqlar


HAMMA BASHORATNING TO'LIQ MATNI:

  TAURUS (Apr. 20 - May 21)
  This will be an EXCITING week. You'll RECEIVE a
  letter from a friend. At the weekend you'll get
  a special INVITATION. ACCEPT it.

  GEMINI (May 22 - June 21)
  This will be a difficult week. You'll ARGUE WITH
  your best friend. Don't worry — you'll soon be
  friends again.

  CANCER (June 22 - July 22)
  You'll go on a long JOURNEY this week. You'll
  enjoy yourself a lot, but don't drive too fast.

  LEO (July 23 - Aug. 23)
  You'll get some good NEWS in a letter, and
  you'll HAVE A LOT OF FUN on Saturday.

  VIRGO (Aug. 24 - Sept. 23)
  You'll have problems with someone in your
  family. Don't worry — everything will be okay
  soon.

  LIBRA (Sept. 24 - Oct. 23)
  This will be a PLEASANT week. You'll go on a
  short TRIP and you'll have lots of fun.

  SCORPIO (Oct. 24 - Nov. 22)
  You will lose some money on Tuesday. A friend
  will bring you some good news. You'll get an
  invitation at the weekend. Don't accept it.

  SAGITTARIUS (Nov. 23 - Dec. 21)
  This will be a HORRIBLE week. There will be bad
  news on Wednesday and you'll have problems with
  someone in your family. The weekend will be
  better.

  CAPRICORN (Dec. 22 - Jan. 20)
  This won't be a good week for you. You'll have
  problems with your HEALTH. Try to relax.

  AQUARIUS (Jan. 21 - Feb. 18)
  This will be your LUCKY week. You will get a lot
  of money. You'll get an invitation at the
  weekend. Accept it.

  PISCES (Feb. 19 - Mar. 20)
  This will be a bad week. You will have problems
  with your health. Try to rest during the
  weekend. Things will be better next week.

  ARIES (Mar. 21 - Apr. 19)
  It will be a pleasant week for you. You'll meet
  an interesting person and you'll get a lot of
  invitations. Enjoy yourself.


ENG MUHIM GRAMMATIK KUZATUV:
  HAMMA bashorat 'WILL' bilan yozilgan —
  chunki bular BAShORAT (predictions), dalilga
  asoslanmagan (95-betdagi qoida).

  Uchraydigan shakllar:
     'This WILL BE ...'      (tasdiq)
     'You'LL get ...'        (qisqargan: you will)
     'This WON'T be ...'     (inkor: will not)
     'THERE WILL BE bad news' (there will be + OT)
     'IT WILL BE a pleasant week' (it will be)

  Va BUYRUQ gaplar:
     'ACCEPT it.'    'DON'T ACCEPT it.'
     'DON'T WORRY.'  'TRY to relax.'
     'ENJOY yourself.'


DIQQAT — 95-BETDAGI QOIDA ShU YERDA IShLAYAPTI:
  'It WILL BE a pleasant week' — 'pleasant' SIFAT
     → IT will be
  'THERE WILL BE bad news' — 'news' OT
     → THERE will be
  Bitta istisno ham yo'q.

tasks.en: TAURUS (Apr. 20 - May 21): This will be an exciting week. You'll receive a letter from a friend. At the weekend you'll get a special invitation. Accept it.
tasks.uz: BUZOQ (20-apr — 21-may): Bu qiziqarli hafta bo'ladi. Do'stingdan xat olasan. Dam olish kunlari maxsus taklif olasan. Uni qabul qil.
tasks.note:
QALIN so'zlar: exciting, receive, invitation, Accept.
'receive' = olmoq (= get, lekin rasmiyroq).
'accept' = qabul qilmoq (aksi: 'refuse').

tasks.en: GEMINI (May 22 - June 21): This will be a difficult week. You'll argue with your best friend. Don't worry — you'll soon be friends again.
tasks.uz: EGIZAKLAR (22-may — 21-iyun): Bu qiyin hafta bo'ladi. Eng yaqin do'sting bilan janjallashasan. Xavotir olma — tez orada yana do'st bo'lasizlar.
tasks.note:
QALIN: argue with.
'argue WITH sb' = kimdir bilan janjallashmoq.
DIQQAT: predlog WITH.

tasks.en: CANCER (June 22 - July 22): You'll go on a long journey this week. You'll enjoy yourself a lot, but don't drive too fast.
tasks.uz: QISQICHBAQA (22-iyun — 22-iyul): Bu hafta uzoq safarga chiqasan. Juda zavqlanasan, lekin tez haydama.
tasks.note:
QALIN: journey.
'a journey' = safar (uzoq).
'go ON a journey' — predlog ON.
'enjoy YOURSELF' — o'zlik olmoshi.

tasks.en: LEO (July 23 - Aug. 23): You'll get some good news in a letter, and you'll have a lot of fun on Saturday.
tasks.uz: ARSLON (23-iyul — 23-avg): Xatda yaxshi yangilik olasan va shanba kuni juda ko'ngilli vaqt o'tkazasan.
tasks.note:
QALIN: news, have a lot of fun.
'news' — SANALMAYDIGAN ot ('a news' XATO).
'have fun' = ko'ngilli vaqt o'tkazmoq.

tasks.en: VIRGO (Aug. 24 - Sept. 23): You'll have problems with someone in your family. Don't worry — everything will be okay soon.
tasks.uz: PARIZOD (24-avg — 23-sent): Oilangdagi kimdir bilan muammoing bo'ladi. Xavotir olma — tez orada hammasi yaxshi bo'ladi.
tasks.note:
'have problems WITH sb' — predlog WITH.
'everything' — BIRLIK → 'will be'.

tasks.en: LIBRA (Sept. 24 - Oct. 23): This will be a pleasant week. You'll go on a short trip and you'll have lots of fun.
tasks.uz: TAROZI (24-sent — 23-okt): Bu yoqimli hafta bo'ladi. Qisqa sayohatga chiqasan va juda ko'ngilli vaqt o'tkazasan.
tasks.note:
QALIN: pleasant, trip.
'pleasant' = yoqimli.
'a trip' = qisqa sayohat ('a journey' — uzoq).
'lots of fun' = 'a lot of fun'.

tasks.en: SCORPIO (Oct. 24 - Nov. 22): You will lose some money on Tuesday. A friend will bring you some good news. You'll get an invitation at the weekend. Don't accept it.
tasks.uz: CHAYON (24-okt — 22-noy): Seshanba kuni bir oz pul yo'qotasan. Do'sting senga yaxshi yangilik keltiradi. Dam olish kunlari taklif olasan. Uni qabul qilma.
tasks.note:
'lose money' = pul yo'qotmoq.
DIQQAT: Taurus va Aquarius 'ACCEPT it' deydi,
Scorpio esa 'DON'T ACCEPT it' — TESKARI.

tasks.en: SAGITTARIUS (Nov. 23 - Dec. 21): This will be a horrible week. There will be bad news on Wednesday and you'll have problems with someone in your family. The weekend will be better.
tasks.uz: YOY (23-noy — 21-dek): Bu dahshatli hafta bo'ladi. Chorshanba kuni yomon yangilik bo'ladi va oilangdagi kimdir bilan muammoing bo'ladi. Dam olish kunlari yaxshiroq bo'ladi.
tasks.note:
QALIN: horrible.
'horrible' = dahshatli (juda yomon).
'THERE WILL BE bad news' — 'news' OT → THERE.
'BETTER' — 'good' ning qiyosiy shakli.

tasks.en: CAPRICORN (Dec. 22 - Jan. 20): This won't be a good week for you. You'll have problems with your health. Try to relax.
tasks.uz: ECHKI (22-dek — 20-yanv): Bu sen uchun yaxshi hafta bo'lmaydi. Sog'ligingda muammo bo'ladi. Dam olishga harakat qil.
tasks.note:
QALIN: health.
'won't' = 'will not' — INKOR.
'health' = sog'liq (SANALMAYDIGAN).
'try TO relax' — 'try to + fe'l'.

tasks.en: AQUARIUS (Jan. 21 - Feb. 18): This will be your lucky week. You will get a lot of money. You'll get an invitation at the weekend. Accept it.
tasks.uz: QOVGA (21-yanv — 18-fev): Bu sening omadli hafting bo'ladi. Ko'p pul olasan. Dam olish kunlari taklif olasan. Uni qabul qil.
tasks.note:
QALIN: lucky.
'lucky' = omadli.
Yagona bashorat 'a lot of MONEY' haqida —
12b-mashqning 4-savoli uchun.

tasks.en: PISCES (Feb. 19 - Mar. 20): This will be a bad week. You will have problems with your health. Try to rest during the weekend. Things will be better next week.
tasks.uz: BALIQLAR (19-fev — 20-mart): Bu yomon hafta bo'ladi. Sog'ligingda muammo bo'ladi. Dam olish kunlari dam olishga harakat qil. Keyingi hafta hammasi yaxshiroq bo'ladi.
tasks.note:
'health' — Capricorn bilan bir xil mavzu
(12b-mashqning 3-savoli).
'during' = ... davomida.
'next week' — 'the' YO'Q.

tasks.en: ARIES (Mar. 21 - Apr. 19): It will be a pleasant week for you. You'll meet an interesting person and you'll get a lot of invitations. Enjoy yourself.
tasks.uz: QO'Y (21-mart — 19-apr): Bu sen uchun yoqimli hafta bo'ladi. Qiziqarli odam bilan uchrashasan va ko'plab takliflar olasan. Zavqlan.
tasks.note:
'IT will be a pleasant week' — 'pleasant' SIFAT
→ IT (95-betdagi qoida).
'invitationS' — KO'PLIK (12b, 2-savol).
'Enjoy yourself' — buyruq + o'zlik olmoshi.

exercises.instructionEn: Which month were you born in? What is your star sign? Read the sentences, then listen to Madame Annette and write T (for true) or F (for false).
exercises.instructionUz: Qaysi oyda tug'ilgansiz? Burjingiz qaysi? Gaplarni o'qing, so'ng Madam Annetni tinglang va T (to'g'ri) yoki F (noto'g'ri) deb yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
OLTI GAP — HAR BIRI BITTA BURJ HAQIDA.

DIQQAT — AUDIO KERAK EMAS:
  Oltala javob ham shu betdagi BOSILGAN
  bashoratlardan so'zma-so'z tekshiriladi.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  Taurus: This will be a difficult week.   F
  2  Cancer: You'll go on a short journey.    F
  3  Leo: You'll get some good news in a
     letter.                                 T
  4  Libra: This will be a bad week.          F
  5  Capricorn: This won't be a good week
     for you.                                T
  6  Aquarius: This will be your lucky week.  T

  T — UCHTA:  3, 5, 6
  F — UCHTA:  1, 2, 4


HAR BIRI QANDAY TEKShIRILADI:

  1  Gap: 'This will be a DIFFICULT week.'
     Bashorat: 'This will be an EXCITING week.'
     → F. ('difficult' — bu GEMINI ning so'zi!)

  2  Gap: 'You'll go on a SHORT journey.'
     Bashorat: 'You'll go on a LONG journey.'
     → F. ('short' — bu LIBRA ning so'zi!)

  3  Gap: 'You'll get some good news in a letter.'
     Bashorat: 'You'll get some good news in a
     letter.'
     → T. SO'ZMA-SO'Z bir xil.

  4  Gap: 'This will be a BAD week.'
     Bashorat: 'This will be a PLEASANT week.'
     → F. ('bad' — bu PISCES ning so'zi!)

  5  Gap: 'This won't be a good week for you.'
     Bashorat: 'This won't be a good week for you.'
     → T. SO'ZMA-SO'Z bir xil.

  6  Gap: 'This will be your lucky week.'
     Bashorat: 'This will be your lucky week.'
     → T. SO'ZMA-SO'Z bir xil.


NAQSh — KITOB QANDAY ALDAYDI:
  Uchala 'F' bandida kitob BOShQA burjning
  so'zini olib qo'ygan:
     'difficult' — aslida Gemini niki
     'short'     — aslida Libra niki
     'bad'       — aslida Pisces niki

  Uchala 'T' bandida esa so'zma-so'z ko'chirilgan.

  Ya'ni: gapdagi SIFATNI bashoratdagi sifat bilan
  solishtirish yetarli.


BURJINGIZNI ANIQLASh:
  Tug'ilgan oyingiz va kuningizga qarab
  yuqoridagi sanalar ro'yxatidan toping.
  Masalan: 15-avgust → LEO (July 23 - Aug. 23).


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a star sign = burj
  a horoscope = munajjimlar bashorati
  Madame     = xonim (fransuzcha murojaat)

tasks.prompt: Taurus: This will be a difficult week.
tasks.answer: F
tasks.whyUz:
NOTO'G'RI (F).
Taurus bashorati: 'This will be an EXCITING
week.' — QIZIQARLI, qiyin emas.
DIQQAT: 'difficult' so'zi aslida GEMINI ning
bashoratida bor ('This will be a difficult
week').
tasks.speak: Taurus: This will be a difficult week.

tasks.prompt: Cancer: You'll go on a short journey this week.
tasks.answer: F
tasks.whyUz:
NOTO'G'RI (F).
Cancer bashorati: 'You'll go on a LONG journey
this week.' — UZOQ safar, qisqa emas.
DIQQAT: 'short' so'zi aslida LIBRA ning
bashoratida bor ('a short trip').
tasks.speak: Cancer: You'll go on a short journey this week.

tasks.prompt: Leo: You'll get some good news in a letter.
tasks.answer: T
tasks.whyUz:
TO'G'RI (T).

exercises.instructionEn: Read the horoscopes and answer the questions. For some questions, there is more than one correct answer.
exercises.instructionUz: Bashoratlarni o'qing va savollarga javob bering. Ba'zi savollarda bittadan ortiq to'g'ri javob bor.
exercises.explanationUz:
BESh SAVOL: 'Which horoscope says ...?'
(Qaysi bashoratda shunday deyilgan?)

DIQQAT — KITOB OGOHLANTIRADI:
  'For some questions, there is MORE THAN ONE
   correct answer.'
  Ya'ni ba'zi savollarda BIR NEChTA javob bor.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

  1  you'll receive a letter from a friend?
     →  TAURUS                       (kitob bergan)

  2  you'll get an invitation/invitations?
     →  TAURUS, SCORPIO, AQUARIUS, ARIES  (TO'RTTA)

  3  you'll have health problems?
     →  CAPRICORN, PISCES                 (IKKITA)

  4  you'll get a lot of money?
     →  AQUARIUS                          (BITTA)

  5  you'll have problems with someone in your
     family?
     →  VIRGO, SAGITTARIUS                (IKKITA)


HAR BIRI QAYERDAN:

  1  TAURUS: 'You'll RECEIVE A LETTER FROM A
     FRIEND.'
     DIQQAT: Leo da ham xat bor, lekin u
     'get some good news IN A LETTER' —
     do'stdan xat OLISh emas.
     Scorpio da esa 'A FRIEND will BRING you some
     good news' — xat emas.

  2  TAURUS:   'you'll get a special INVITATION'
     SCORPIO:  'You'll get an INVITATION at the
                weekend'
     AQUARIUS: 'You'll get an INVITATION at the
                weekend'
     ARIES:    'you'll get a lot of INVITATIONS'
     → TO'RTTA bashorat.
     DIQQAT: savolda 'invitation/invitationS' —
     kitob ataylab ikkala shaklni bergan, chunki
     Aries da KO'PLIK.

  3  CAPRICORN: 'You'll have problems with your
                HEALTH.'
     PISCES:    'You will have problems with your
                HEALTH.'
     → IKKITA bashorat, deyarli bir xil so'zlar.

  4  AQUARIUS: 'You will get A LOT OF MONEY.'
     → FAQAT BITTA.
     DIQQAT: Scorpio da pul bor, lekin
     'You will LOSE some money' — YO'QOTASAN,
     olmaysan. Bu TESKARI.

  5  VIRGO:       'You'll have problems with
                  SOMEONE IN YOUR FAMILY.'
     SAGITTARIUS: 'you'll have problems with
                  SOMEONE IN YOUR FAMILY.'
     → IKKITA bashorat, so'zma-so'z bir xil.


ENG ALDAMChI NUQTALAR:

  1-SAVOL: Uchta bashoratda 'letter' yoki 'friend'
     bor, lekin faqat TAURUS da 'do'stdan XAT
     OLISh' bor.

  4-SAVOL: Scorpio da ham 'money' bor, lekin
     'LOSE money' (yo'qotmoq) — savolda esa 'GET
     money' (olmoq). TESKARI ma'no.


DIQQAT — TAKLIF QABUL QILISh:
  Uchta bashorat taklif haqida gapiradi, lekin
  maslahat HAR XIL:
     TAURUS:   'ACCEPT it.'        (qabul qil)
     AQUARIUS: 'ACCEPT it.'        (qabul qil)
     SCORPIO:  'DON'T ACCEPT it.'  (qabul qilma)
  Bu — 4-modulda o'rganiladigan 'accept/refuse
  invitations' ko'nikmasiga tayyorgarlik.

4  you'll get a lot of money?

exercises.explanationUz:
BASHORATLARDAGI QALIN SO'ZLAR —
HAMMASI TUShUNTIRILGAN.

Jami 13 ta so'z va ibora.

tasks.en: exciting  (Taurus)
tasks.uz: qiziqarli, hayajonli
tasks.note:
'This will be an EXCITING week.'
= juda qiziqarli hafta.
DIQQAT: 'exciting' — NARSA haqida,
'excited' — ODAM haqida (hayajonlangan).
Unit 12 da ham uchragan.

tasks.en: to receive  (Taurus)
tasks.uz: olmoq
tasks.note:
'You'll RECEIVE a letter.'
= 'You'll GET a letter', lekin RASMIYROQ.
Aksi: 'to send' (yubormoq).

tasks.en: an invitation  (Taurus)
tasks.uz: taklif
tasks.note:
'you'll get a special INVITATION'
Fe'li: 'to invite' (taklif qilmoq).
4-modulning ko'nikmalaridan biri:
'accept/refuse invitations'.

tasks.en: to accept  (Taurus)
tasks.uz: qabul qilmoq
tasks.note:
'ACCEPT it.' = Uni qabul qil.
Aksi: 'to REFUSE' (rad etmoq).
DIQQAT: Scorpio da 'DON'T ACCEPT it' —
teskari maslahat.

tasks.en: to argue with sb  (Gemini)
tasks.uz: kimdir bilan janjallashmoq
tasks.note:
'You'll ARGUE WITH your best friend.'
DIQQAT: predlog WITH.
Ot shakli: 'an argument' (janjal, bahs).

tasks.en: a journey  (Cancer)
tasks.uz: safar (uzoq)
tasks.note:
'You'll go on a long JOURNEY.'
'go ON a journey' — predlog ON.
DIQQAT: 'a journey' — UZOQ safar,
'a trip' — QISQA sayohat (Libra da).

tasks.en: news  (Leo)
tasks.uz: yangilik
tasks.note:
'You'll get some good NEWS in a letter.'
SANALMAYDIGAN ot: 'a news' XATO,
'some news' ✓.
Fe'l ham BIRLIKDA: 'The news IS good.'

tasks.en: to have a lot of fun  (Leo)
tasks.uz: juda ko'ngilli vaqt o'tkazmoq
tasks.note:
'you'll HAVE A LOT OF FUN on Saturday.'
'fun' — SANALMAYDIGAN ot.
'lots of fun' = 'a lot of fun' (Libra da).

tasks.en: pleasant  (Libra)
tasks.uz: yoqimli
tasks.note:
'This will be a PLEASANT week.'
= yoqimli, xush.
Aries da ham bor: 'It will be a pleasant week
for you.'

tasks.en: a trip  (Libra)
tasks.uz: qisqa sayohat
tasks.note:
'You'll go on a short TRIP.'
DIQQAT: 'a trip' — QISQA,
'a journey' — UZOQ (Cancer da).
'go ON a trip' — predlog ON.

tasks.en: horrible  (Sagittarius)
tasks.uz: dahshatli
tasks.note:
'This will be a HORRIBLE week.'
= juda yomon.
'horror' (dahshat) so'zidan.
Aksi: 'wonderful', 'lovely'.

tasks.en: health  (Capricorn)
tasks.uz: sog'liq
tasks.note:
'You'll have problems with your HEALTH.'
SANALMAYDIGAN ot.
Sifati: 'healthy' (sog'lom).
Pisces da ham bor.

tasks.en: lucky  (Aquarius)
tasks.uz: omadli
tasks.note:
'This will be your LUCKY week.'
Ot shakli: 'luck' (omad).
Aksi: 'unlucky' (omadsiz).
Ravish: 'luckily' (omadga ko'ra).

exercises.instructionEn: Read the dialogue (Paul and Tony).
exercises.instructionUz: Dialogni o'qing (Pol va Toni).
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'LIQ DIALOG:

  Paul: Hi, Tony! I hear you're going to spend
        your summer holidays in Australia.
  Tony: Yes, I am. I'm going there BECAUSE I want
        to see my sister and her family.
  Paul: That sounds nice. Are you going to stay
        there long?
  Tony: Yes. I want to travel around while I'm
        there, SO I'm going to stay there for two
        months.
  Paul: Great! What are you going to do there?
  Tony: Well, I'm going to visit Sydney TO SEE the
        Opera House. I also want to visit
        Canberra, the capital city, SO I'm going
        to hire a car.
  Paul: You're so lucky! Are you going to take a
        boat out to the Great Barrier Reef?
  Tony: Yes, I really want to see all the
        colourful fish there.
  Paul: I'm sure you'll have a great time.
  Tony: Well, I'm going to take my video camera
        BECAUSE I want to show everyone what
        Australia is like when I get back.
  Paul: That's a great idea. Have fun!


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:

  Pol:  Salom, Toni! Yozgi ta'tilingni
        Avstraliyada o'tkazmoqchi ekansan, deb
        eshitdim.
  Toni: Ha, shunday. U yerga boryapman, chunki
        opamni va uning oilasini ko'rmoqchiman.
  Pol:  Yaxshi ekan. U yerda uzoq turasanmi?
  Toni: Ha. U yerda bo'lganimda atrofni aylanib
        chiqmoqchiman, shuning uchun ikki oy
        turaman.
  Pol:  Zo'r! U yerda nima qilmoqchisan?
  Toni: Opera teatrini ko'rish uchun Sidneyga
        bormoqchiman. Shuningdek, poytaxt
        Kanberraga ham bormoqchiman, shuning
        uchun mashina ijaraga olaman.
  Pol:  Juda omading bor ekan! Katta to'siq
        rifiga qayiqda chiqmoqchimisan?
  Toni: Ha, u yerdagi rang-barang baliqlarni juda
        ko'rgim keladi.
  Pol:  Ishonchim komilki, ajoyib vaqt
        o'tkazasan.
  Toni: Ha, videokamerani olib ketmoqchiman,
        chunki qaytganimda hammaga Avstraliya
        qanaqaligini ko'rsatmoqchiman.
  Pol:  Bu zo'r fikr. Yaxshi dam ol!


ENG MUHIM — DIALOGDA UCh XIL SABAB IFODASI:

  BECAUSE (sabab):
     'I'm going there BECAUSE I want to see my
      sister.'
     'I'm going to take my video camera BECAUSE I
      want to show everyone ...'

  SO (natija):
     'I want to travel around ..., SO I'm going to
      stay for two months.'
     'I also want to visit Canberra ..., SO I'm
      going to hire a car.'

  TO + fe'l (maqsad):
     'I'm going to visit Sydney TO SEE the Opera
      House.'

  Bu — Unit 13 ning asosiy ko'nikmasi
  (Coursebook 95-bet, Grammar 57 va 59-betlar).


AVSTRALIYA HAQIDA:
  Sydney   — eng katta shahar, Opera teatri bilan
             mashhur
  Canberra — POYTAXT (Sidney emas!)
  the Great Barrier Reef — Katta to'siq rifi,
             dunyodagi eng katta marjon rifi


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to spend holidays = ta'tilni o'tkazmoq
  to travel around  = atrofni aylanib chiqmoq
  the capital city  = poytaxt
  to hire a car     = mashina ijaraga olmoq
  a reef            = rif (marjon to'sig'i)
  colourful         = rang-barang
  a video camera    = videokamera
  to get back       = qaytmoq
  Have fun!         = Yaxshi dam ol!

tasks.en: Paul: Hi, Tony! I hear you're going to spend your summer holidays in Australia.
tasks.uz: Pol: Salom, Toni! Yozgi ta'tilingni Avstraliyada o'tkazmoqchi ekansan, deb eshitdim.
tasks.note:
'I hear ...' = eshitdim, xabarim bor.
'spend holidays IN + mamlakat' — predlog IN.

tasks.en: Tony: Yes, I am. I'm going there because I want to see my sister and her family.
tasks.uz: Toni: Ha, shunday. U yerga boryapman, chunki opamni va uning oilasini ko'rmoqchiman.
tasks.note:
'Yes, I AM' — qisqa javob
('Are you going to ...?' savoliga).
BECAUSE — SABAB.
14b-mashqning 1-bandi shu yerdan.

tasks.en: Paul: That sounds nice. Are you going to stay there long?
tasks.uz: Pol: Yaxshi ekan. U yerda uzoq turasanmi?
tasks.note:
'That sounds nice' = Yaxshi ekan
(reaksiya iborasi).
'stay LONG' — 'a long time' ning qisqasi.

tasks.en: Tony: Yes. I want to travel around while I'm there, so I'm going to stay there for two months.
tasks.uz: Toni: Ha. U yerda bo'lganimda atrofni aylanib chiqmoqchiman, shuning uchun ikki oy turaman.
tasks.note:
SO — NATIJA.
'WHILE I'm there' — 'while' dan keyin
PRESENT SIMPLE ('while I will be' XATO).
'FOR two months' — davomiylik FOR.

tasks.en: Tony: Well, I'm going to visit Sydney to see the Opera House.
tasks.uz: Toni: Opera teatrini ko'rish uchun Sidneyga bormoqchiman.
tasks.note:
TO + fe'l — MAQSAD.
Sidney — Avstraliyaning eng katta shahri.
'the Opera House' — Sidney opera teatri.

tasks.en: Tony: I also want to visit Canberra, the capital city, so I'm going to hire a car.
tasks.uz: Toni: Shuningdek, poytaxt Kanberraga ham bormoqchiman, shuning uchun mashina ijaraga olaman.
tasks.note:
SO — NATIJA.
DIQQAT: Avstraliya poytaxti — KANBERRA,
Sidney EMAS (ko'p odam adashadi).
'to hire a car' = mashina ijaraga olmoq.

tasks.en: Paul: You're so lucky! Are you going to take a boat out to the Great Barrier Reef?
tasks.uz: Pol: Juda omading bor ekan! Katta to'siq rifiga qayiqda chiqmoqchimisan?
tasks.note:
'You're so lucky!' = Omading bor ekan!
'take a boat OUT TO ...' = qayiqda chiqmoq.
'the Great Barrier Reef' — dunyodagi eng katta
marjon rifi (Avstraliya sohilida).

tasks.en: Tony: Yes, I really want to see all the colourful fish there.
tasks.uz: Toni: Ha, u yerdagi rang-barang baliqlarni juda ko'rgim keladi.
tasks.note:
'really' — kuchaytiruvchi.
'FISH' — ko'pligi ham 'fish'
('fishes' odatda aytilmaydi).
'colourful' = rang-barang (britancha yozilishi;
amerikacha 'colorful').

tasks.en: Paul: I'm sure you'll have a great time.
tasks.uz: Pol: Ishonchim komilki, ajoyib vaqt o'tkazasan.
tasks.note:
'I'M SURE ... WILL ...' — FIKRGA asoslangan
bashorat (Grammar 58-bet qoidasi).
'have a great time' = ajoyib vaqt o'tkazmoq.

tasks.en: Tony: Well, I'm going to take my video camera because I want to show everyone what Australia is like when I get back.
tasks.uz: Toni: Ha, videokamerani olib ketmoqchiman, chunki qaytganimda hammaga Avstraliya qanaqaligini ko'rsatmoqchiman.
tasks.note:
BECAUSE — SABAB.
'what Australia IS LIKE' — 'like' bu yerda
'qanday' ma'nosida (Unit 12 dan).
'WHEN I GET back' — 'when' dan keyin
PRESENT SIMPLE ('when I will get' XATO).

tasks.en: Paul: That's a great idea. Have fun!
tasks.uz: Pol: Bu zo'r fikr. Yaxshi dam ol!
tasks.note:
'Have fun!' = Yaxshi dam ol! (xayrlashuv tilagi).
Buyruq gap shaklida.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the dialogue and mark the statements below as T (true) or F (false).
exercises.instructionUz: Dialogni o'qing va quyidagi gaplarni T (to'g'ri) yoki F (noto'g'ri) deb belgilang.
exercises.explanationUz:
BESh GAP — javoblar dialogdan TO'G'RIDAN-TO'G'RI
tekshiriladi.

BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  Tony's going to America this summer.    F
  2  Tony's going to see his sister.         T
  3  Tony's going to hire a bicycle.         F
  4  Tony's going to see the Opera House.    T
  5  Tony's going to take his stereo.        F

  T — IKKITA:  2, 4
  F — UChTA:   1, 3, 5


NAQSh — KITOB QANDAY ALDAYDI:
  Uchala 'F' bandida kitob BITTA so'zni
  almashtirgan:
     America  ←  aslida AUSTRALIA
     bicycle  ←  aslida a CAR
     stereo   ←  aslida a VIDEO CAMERA

  Ya'ni gapning tuzilishi to'g'ri, faqat
  BITTA SO'Z noto'g'ri. Diqqat bilan o'qish
  kerak.


HAR BIRI QANDAY TEKShIRILADI:

  1  Dialog: 'spend your summer holidays in
     AUSTRALIA'
     Gap: 'going to AMERICA'
     → F. Mamlakat NOTO'G'RI.

  2  Dialog: 'I want to see MY SISTER and her
     family'
     Gap: 'going to see his sister'
     → T. TO'G'RI.

  3  Dialog: 'I'm going to hire A CAR'
     Gap: 'going to hire A BICYCLE'
     → F. Transport NOTO'G'RI.

  4  Dialog: 'I'm going to visit Sydney to see
     THE OPERA HOUSE'
     Gap: 'going to see the Opera House'
     → T. TO'G'RI.

  5  Dialog: 'I'm going to take MY VIDEO CAMERA'
     Gap: 'going to take his STEREO'
     → F. Narsa NOTO'G'RI.


DIQQAT — OLMOSh O'ZGARADI:
  Dialogda Toni O'ZI gapiradi: 'MY sister',
  'MY video camera'.
  Gaplarda esa uchinchi shaxs: 'HIS sister',
  'HIS stereo'.
  Bu — normal, xato emas.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a stereo  = musiqa markazi, magnitofon
  a bicycle = velosiped

tasks.answer: T

Dialogda: 'I'm going to visit Sydney TO SEE THE

Sidney opera teatri — Avstraliyaning eng mashhur

exercises.instructionEn: Now fill in the chart below with the reasons.
exercises.instructionUz: Endi quyidagi jadvalni sabablar bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
JADVAL IKKI USTUNDAN IBORAT:
  PLANS/INTENTIONS  (rejalar va niyatlar)
  REASON/PURPOSE    (sabab va maqsad)

Kitob har ikki ustunning BIR QISMINI bergan —
qolganini dialogdan topib to'ldirasiz.


TO'LDIRILGAN JADVAL:

 ┌──────────────────────────┬──────────────────────┐
 │ PLANS/INTENTIONS         │ REASON/PURPOSE       │
 ├──────────────────────────┼──────────────────────┤
 │ Tony's going to spend    │ He wants to see his  │
 │ his SUMMER HOLIDAYS IN   │ sister and her       │
 │ AUSTRALIA        (NAMUNA)│ family.     (NAMUNA) │
 ├──────────────────────────┼──────────────────────┤
 │ He's going to stay there │ He wants to TRAVEL   │
 │ for TWO MONTHS           │ around while he's    │
 │                          │ there.               │
 ├──────────────────────────┼──────────────────────┤
 │ He's going to visit      │ He wants to SEE the  │
 │ SYDNEY                   │ Opera House.         │
 ├──────────────────────────┼──────────────────────┤
 │ He's going to hire       │ He wants to VISIT    │
 │ A CAR                    │ Canberra the capital │
 │                          │ city.                │
 ├──────────────────────────┼──────────────────────┤
 │ He's going to take a     │ He wants to SEE all  │
 │ BOAT (out to the Great   │ the colourful fish.  │
 │ Barrier Reef)            │                      │
 ├──────────────────────────┼──────────────────────┤
 │ He's going to take his   │ He wants to SHOW     │
 │ VIDEO CAMERA             │ everyone what        │
 │                          │ Australia is like    │
 │                          │ when he gets back.   │
 └──────────────────────────┴──────────────────────┘


QOLIP — SABAB USTUNI:
  'He WANTS TO + ASOSIY fe'l + ... .'

  Dialogda Toni O'ZI gapiradi ('I want to ...'),
  jadvalda esa UChINChI ShAXS ('He wants to ...').


HAR BIRI DIALOGNING QAYSI QATORIDAN:

  1  'I'm going there BECAUSE I WANT TO SEE my
      sister and her family.'

  2  'I WANT TO TRAVEL AROUND while I'm there, SO
      I'm going to stay there for two months.'

  3  'I'm going to visit Sydney TO SEE the Opera
      House.'
     → jadvalda: 'He wants to SEE the Opera House.'

  4  'I also WANT TO VISIT Canberra, the capital
      city, SO I'm going to hire a car.'

  5  'I really WANT TO SEE all the colourful fish
      there.'

  6  'I'm going to take my video camera BECAUSE I
      WANT TO SHOW everyone what Australia is like
      when I get back.'


ENG MUHIM KUZATUV:
  Dialogda sabab UCh xil ifodalangan
  (because / so / to + fe'l), lekin jadvalda
  HAMMASI BIR XIL shaklga keltiriladi:
     'He WANTS TO ...'

  Bu — 15-mashqdagi xat uchun tayyorgarlik.


DIQQAT — 'WHILE HE'S THERE' va 'WHEN HE GETS
BACK':
  Ikkalasida ham PRESENT SIMPLE:
     'while he'S there'   ('while he will be' XATO)
     'when he GETS back'  ('when he will get' XATO)

  'while' va 'when' dan keyin KELASI zamon
  IShLATILMAYDI.

exercises.instructionEn: Expressing Plans and Intentions
exercises.instructionUz: Rejalar va niyatlarni ifodalash
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI JADVAL — 'BE GOING TO' NING TO'RT
ShAKLI:

 ┌───────────────┬──────────────────────────────┐
 │ AFFIRMATIVE   │ I AM / You ARE / He IS, etc  │
 │ (tasdiq)      │ GOING TO move house.         │
 ├───────────────┼──────────────────────────────┤
 │ NEGATIVE      │ I'M NOT / You AREN'T /       │
 │ (inkor)       │ He ISN'T, etc                │
 │               │ GOING TO move house.         │
 ├───────────────┼──────────────────────────────┤
 │ INTERROGATIVE │ AM I / ARE you / IS he, etc  │
 │ (so'roq)      │ GOING TO move house?         │
 ├───────────────┼──────────────────────────────┤
 │ SHORT ANSWERS │ Yes, I AM / you ARE /        │
 │ (qisqa javob) │      he IS, etc.             │
 │               │ No, I'M NOT / you AREN'T /   │
 │               │     he ISN'T, etc.           │
 └───────────────┴──────────────────────────────┘


ENG MUHIM QOIDA:
  'be going to' da O'ZGARADIGAN QISM faqat
  'BE' fe'li (am / is / are).
  'going to' HECh QAChON o'zgarmaydi.

  TASDIQ:  ega + AM/IS/ARE + going to + fe'l
  INKOR:   ega + AM/IS/ARE + NOT + going to + fe'l
  SO'ROQ:  AM/IS/ARE + ega + going to + fe'l?


DIQQAT — INKORDA 'NOT' QAYERDA:
  'be' fe'lidan KEYIN:
     I AM NOT going to ...   → I'M NOT going to ...
     You ARE NOT going to ... → You AREN'T going to ...
     He IS NOT going to ...  → He ISN'T going to ...

  'I don't going to' XATO —
  'do/does' KERAK EMAS.


DIQQAT — SO'ROQDA 'BE' OLDINGA ChIQADI:
     'Are you going to move house?'  ✓
     'Do you going to move house?'   ✗


DIQQAT — QISQA JAVOBDA 'GOING TO' TAKRORLANMAYDI:
     'Are you going to move house?'
     'Yes, I AM.'          ✓
     'Yes, I am going to.' — to'liq, lekin qisqa
                             javob emas


'MOVE HOUSE' NIMA:
  'to move house' = boshqa uyga ko'chib o'tmoq.
  DIQQAT: 'house' oldidan artikl YO'Q —
  bu turg'un ibora.

exercises.instructionEn: be going to - present continuous
exercises.instructionUz: be going to va present continuous
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI IKKINChI QUTI:

  'We use BE GOING TO to talk about FUTURE PLANS
   AND INTENTIONS. We use the PRESENT CONTINUOUS
   to talk about FIXED FUTURE ARRANGEMENTS.'

  = 'be going to' ni KELAJAK REJALARI va
    NIYATLARI haqida gapirish uchun ishlatamiz.
    'present continuous' ni esa QAT'IY
    BELGILANGAN kelajak ishlari haqida gapirish
    uchun ishlatamiz.


KITOBDAGI IKKI RASM VA GAP:

  CHAP RASM — plans/intentions (BE GOING TO)
     Yigit qizga gapiryapti:
     'I'M GOING TO fly to Poland SOON.'
     (Yaqinda Polshaga uchmoqchiman.)
     → 'soon' = yaqinda — ANIQ vaqt YO'Q.
       Hali chipta olinmagan, faqat NIYAT.

  O'NG RASM — fixed arrangements
               (PRESENT CONTINUOUS)
     Yigit qo'lida ChIPTA ushlab turibdi:
     'I'M FLYING to Poland AT 7 O'CLOCK.'
     (Soat yettida Polshaga uchaman.)
     → 'at 7 o'clock' = ANIQ vaqt.
       Chipta olingan, hamma narsa TAYYOR.

  DIQQAT: rasmda yigitning qo'lida ChIPTA bor —
  kitob shu bilan farqni KO'RSATMOQDA.


ENG SODDA QOIDA:

     ANIQ VAQT (sana, soat) bormi?
        HA   →  PRESENT CONTINUOUS
        YO'Q →  BE GOING TO


JENNINING XATIDA BU QOIDA ANIQ IShLAGAN:

  BE GOING TO (sana YO'Q):
     'we're GOING TO stay at a fabulous hotel'
     'I'm GOING TO relax'
     'I'm GOING TO work at a cafe'
     'I'm GOING TO join a gym'
     'I'm GOING TO start a computer course'

  PRESENT CONTINUOUS (sana BOR):
     'We're LEAVING ON 1ST JUNE.'
     'We're COMING BACK ... ON 30TH JUNE.'
     'ON 16TH AUGUST we're HAVING a garden party.'

  BEShTA 'be going to' — hech qaysisida sana yo'q.
  UChTA 'present continuous' — uchalasida ham
  sana bor.
  BITTA ISTISNO ham yo'q.


QO'ShIMChA MISOLLAR:

  'I'm going to visit my grandmother.'
     (Buvimnikiga bormoqchiman — qachonligi
      hali aniq emas.)

  'I'm visiting my grandmother on Sunday.'
     (Yakshanba kuni buvimnikiga boraman —
      kelishilgan.)

  'We're going to move house.'
     (Ko'chib o'tmoqchimiz — reja.)

  'We're moving house next Friday.'
     (Keyingi juma ko'chib o'tamiz — sana
      belgilangan.)

exercises.instructionEn: Choose activities from the list and say three things you are going to do at the weekend, and three things you are not going to do.
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdan mashg'ulotlarni tanlang va dam olish kunlarida QILMOQCHI bo'lgan uchta ish hamda QILMOQCHI EMAS uchta ish haqida ayting.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (9 ta mashg'ulot):
  stay at home            (uyda qolmoq)
  watch TV                (televizor ko'rmoq)
  meet my friends         (do'stlarim bilan
                           uchrashmoq)
  have a party            (ziyofat qilmoq)
  play football           (futbol o'ynamoq)
  study for a test        (imtihonga tayyorlanmoq)
  fly to New Delhi        (Nyu-Delhiga uchmoq)
  listen to music and relax (musiqa tinglab dam
                             olmoq)
  clean my room           (xonamni yig'ishtirmoq)


KITOBDAGI IKKI NAMUNA:
  ✓ 'I'M GOING TO listen to music and relax.'
  ✗ 'I'M NOT GOING TO fly to New Delhi.'


TOPShIRIQ:
  UChTA ✓ gap  +  UChTA ✗ gap = jami OLTITA


QOLIP:
  ✓  I'M GOING TO + ASOSIY fe'l.
  ✗  I'M NOT GOING TO + ASOSIY fe'l.

  DIQQAT: 'I' bilan DOIM 'AM' →
  'I'm going to' / 'I'm not going to'.


NAMUNA JAVOB (oltita gap):

  QILMOQChIMAN (✓):
     I'm going to listen to music and relax.
                                        (NAMUNA)
     I'm going to meet my friends.
     I'm going to study for a test.

  QILMOQChI EMASMAN (✗):
     I'm not going to fly to New Delhi.  (NAMUNA)
     I'm not going to have a party.
     I'm not going to clean my room.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  Musiqa tinglab dam olmoqchiman.
  Do'stlarim bilan uchrashmoqchiman.
  Imtihonga tayyorlanmoqchiman.
  Nyu-Delhiga uchmoqchi emasman.
  Ziyofat qilmoqchi emasman.
  Xonamni yig'ishtirmoqchi emasman.


DIQQAT — 'FLY TO NEW DELHI' NEGA NAMUNADA ✗:
  Bu — ro'yxatdagi eng EHTIMOLSIZ ish.
  Kitob uni ataylab ✗ namunasi qilib olgan.


DIQQAT — FE'L BIRIKMALARI:
  'STAY AT home'      — predlog AT, artikl YO'Q
  'WATCH TV'          — 'TV' oldidan artikl YO'Q
  'MEET my friends'   — predlogsiz
  'HAVE a party'      — 'make a party' XATO
  'PLAY football'     — sport oldidan artikl YO'Q
  'STUDY FOR a test'  — predlog FOR
  'FLY TO' + shahar   — predlog TO
  'LISTEN TO music'   — predlog TO
  'CLEAN my room'     — predlogsiz


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a test      = imtihon, nazorat ishi
  to study for = ... ga tayyorlanmoq
  New Delhi   = Nyu-Delhi (Hindiston poytaxti)
  to clean    = tozalamoq, yig'ishtirmoq

exercises.instructionEn: Look at Tom's arrangements, then, in pairs, ask and answer questions, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Tomning belgilangan ishlariga qarang, so'ng juftlikda namunadagidek savol berib, javob bering.
exercises.explanationUz:
TOMNING KUNDALIGI:

     SATURDAY 4th JULY
     ─────────────────────────────────────
     10 am:  visit the dentist
     11 am:  meet Frank for coffee
      1 pm:  have lunch with Jane
      5 pm:  catch the train to London


KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  SA: 'What IS Tom DOING at ten o'clock?'
  SB: 'He'S VISITING the dentist at ten o'clock.'


NEGA PRESENT CONTINUOUS:
  Bu ishlar KUNDALIKKA yozilgan — ya'ni
  QAT'IY BELGILANGAN (fixed arrangements).
  Har birining ANIQ SOATI bor.

  93-betdagi qoida: aniq vaqt bor →
  PRESENT CONTINUOUS.

  'He's GOING TO visit the dentist' bo'lsa —
  shunchaki niyat bo'lardi, kundalikka
  yozilmagan bo'lardi.


QOLIP:
  SAVOL:  What IS + ega + DOING at [soat]?
  JAVOB:  ega + 'S + fe'l-ING + at [soat].


BARCHA TO'RT SAVOL-JAVOB:

  1  SA: What is Tom doing at ten o'clock?
     SB: He's visiting the dentist at ten
         o'clock.                      (NAMUNA)

  2  SA: What is Tom doing at eleven o'clock?
     SB: He's meeting Frank for coffee at eleven
         o'clock.

  3  SA: What is Tom doing at one o'clock?
     SB: He's having lunch with Jane at one
         o'clock.

  4  SA: What is Tom doing at five o'clock?
     SB: He's catching the train to London at five
         o'clock.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  1  Tom soat o'nda nima qiladi? —
     Soat o'nda tish shifokoriga boradi.
  2  Tom soat o'n birda nima qiladi? —
     Soat o'n birda Frank bilan qahva ichgani
     uchrashadi.
  3  Tom soat birda nima qiladi? —
     Soat birda Jeyn bilan tushlik qiladi.
  4  Tom soat beshda nima qiladi? —
     Soat beshda Londonga poyezdga chiqadi.


DIQQAT — 'VISIT THE DENTIST':
  'visit the dentist' = tish shifokoriga bormoq.
  'the dentist' — ANIQ artikl bilan
  ('a dentist' emas), chunki bu turg'un ibora.
  Shunday: 'go to the doctor', 'go to the
  dentist'.

DIQQAT — 'CATCH THE TRAIN':
  'catch a train / bus / plane' = poyezdga
  (avtobusga, samolyotga) chiqmoq, ulgurmoq.
  'to catch' = ushlamoq, lekin transport bilan
  'ulgurib chiqmoq' ma'nosida.
  Aksi: 'to MISS the train' (poyezdni boy bermoq).

DIQQAT — 'MEET sb FOR sth':
  'meet Frank FOR coffee' = Frank bilan qahva
  ichgani uchrashmoq.
  'for' bu yerda MAQSADNI bildiradi.

DIQQAT — SOATLARNI O'QISh:
  10 am → 'ten o'clock' (ertalabki 10)
  11 am → 'eleven o'clock'
   1 pm → 'one o'clock' (kunduzgi 1)
   5 pm → 'five o'clock'
  'am' = tushdan oldin, 'pm' = tushdan keyin.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  an arrangement = belgilangan ish, kelishuv
  a dentist      = tish shifokori
  to catch a train = poyezdga chiqmoq
  am / pm        = tushdan oldin / tushdan keyin

exercises.instructionEn: be going to - present continuous (part 2)
exercises.instructionUz: be going to va present continuous (2-qism)
exercises.explanationUz:
93-BETDAGI QUTINING DAVOMI.

93-betda o'rgangan edik:
  BE GOING TO       →  reja va niyat
  PRESENT CONTINUOUS →  qat'iy belgilangan ish

BU BETDA YANA IKKI VAZIFA:

  • 'We also use BE GOING TO for PREDICTIONS
     BASED ON EVIDENCE IN THE PRESENT.'
    = 'be going to' ni HOZIRGI DALILGA asoslangan
      bashorat uchun ham ishlatamiz.

  • 'We also use the PRESENT CONTINUOUS for
     ACTIONS HAPPENING NOW, at the moment of
     speaking.'
    = 'present continuous' ni HOZIR, gapirayotgan
      paytda sodir bo'layotgan harakat uchun ham
      ishlatamiz.


KITOBDAGI IKKI RASM:

  CHAP RASM — be going to: DALIL
     Odam osmonga qaraydi, osmonda QORA BULUTLAR.
     'There are dark clouds in the sky.
      IT'S GOING TO RAIN.'
     (Osmonda qora bulutlar bor.
      Yomg'ir yog'adi.)
     → Yomg'ir HALI YOG'MAGAN, lekin DALIL bor
       (qora bulutlar) → 'be going to'.

  O'NG RASM — present continuous: HOZIR
     Xuddi shu odam, endi soyabon ostida,
     yomg'ir yog'moqda.
     'IT'S RAINING.'
     (Yomg'ir yog'yapti.)
     → Yomg'ir HOZIR yog'moqda → present
       continuous.


ENDI 'BE GOING TO' NING IKKI VAZIFASI BOR:

  1) REJA va NIYAT (93-bet)
     'I'm going to start a computer course.'
     → o'zim hal qilganman

  2) DALILGA ASOSLANGAN BAShORAT (94-bet)
     'It's going to rain.'
     → osmonda qora bulutlar bor (KO'RINIB
       TURIBDI)


VA 'PRESENT CONTINUOUS' NING HAM IKKI VAZIFASI:

  1) QAT'IY BELGILANGAN kelajak ishi (93-bet)
     'We're leaving on 1st June.'
     → chipta olingan

  2) HOZIR sodir bo'layotgan harakat (94-bet)
     'It's raining.'
     → ayni damda


QANDAY AJRATISh — ENG SODDA USUL:

  Harakat HOZIR sodir bo'layaptimi?
     HA   →  PRESENT CONTINUOUS ('It's raining')
     YO'Q →  hali bo'lmagan:
              vaqti belgilanganmi?
                 HA   → PRESENT CONTINUOUS
                        ('We're leaving on 1st June')
                 YO'Q → BE GOING TO
                        ('It's going to rain')


QO'ShIMChA MISOLLAR — DALILGA ASOSLANGAN BAShORAT:

  'Look at that car! It'S GOING TO crash!'
     (Ana u mashinaga qara! U urilib ketadi!)
     → dalil: mashina nazoratdan chiqqan

  'She's very pale. She'S GOING TO faint.'
     (U juda oqarib ketgan. Hushidan ketadi.)
     → dalil: rangi oqargan

  'The team is playing badly. They'RE GOING TO
   lose.'
     (Jamoa yomon o'ynayapti. Yutqazadi.)
     → dalil: yomon o'yin


DIQQAT — 'WILL' BILAN FARQI:
  'It'S GOING TO rain.'  → DALIL bor (qora bulut)
  'I think it WILL rain.' → shunchaki FIKR, dalil
                            yo'q
  Ikkalasi ham bashorat, lekin asosi boshqa.

tasks.en: We also use be going to for predictions based on evidence in the present.

tasks.note:
