exercises.explanationUz:
DIQQAT — HALOL OGOHLANTIRISh:
  Bu loyiha kitobning oxiridagi 'Photo File'
  bo'limidagi ma'lumotga tayanadi — bizdagi
  skanda o'sha bo'lim YO'Q.

  Shuning uchun quyida SHU BETDAGI 12 bashorat
  asosida tuzilgan QOLIPLAR va NAMUNA berilgan.
  Bu qoliplar bilan istalgan bashoratni yozish
  mumkin.


BAShORAT YOZISh — TUZILISh:

  1) BURJ NOMI va SANALARI
     'Leo (July 23 - Aug. 23)'

  2) HAFTANING UMUMIY TA'RIFI
     'This will be a(n) [SIFAT] week.'
     yoki
     'It will be a [SIFAT] week for you.'

  3) IKKI-UCh BAShORAT
     'You'll [fe'l] ...'

  4) MASLAHAT (buyruq gap)
     'Accept it.' / 'Don't worry.' /
     'Try to relax.' / 'Enjoy yourself.'


FOYDALANISh MUMKIN BO'LGAN SIFATLAR:
  IJOBIY:  exciting, pleasant, lucky, wonderful,
           great, fantastic
  SALBIY:  difficult, bad, horrible, terrible


FOYDALANISh MUMKIN BO'LGAN BAShORATLAR:
  You'll receive a letter from a friend.
  You'll get an invitation.
  You'll go on a long journey / a short trip.
  You'll meet an interesting person.
  You'll get some good news.
  You'll get a lot of money.
  You'll lose some money.
  You'll argue with your best friend.
  You'll have problems with your health.
  You'll have problems with someone in your
  family.
  You'll have a lot of fun.


FOYDALANISh MUMKIN BO'LGAN MASLAHATLAR:
  Accept it.          (Qabul qil.)
  Don't accept it.    (Qabul qilma.)
  Don't worry.        (Xavotir olma.)
  Try to relax.       (Dam olishga harakat qil.)
  Try to rest.        (Dam ol.)
  Enjoy yourself.     (Zavqlan.)
  Don't drive too fast. (Tez haydama.)


TO'LIQ NAMUNA (o'zingiz yozganingizda
shu qolipdan foydalaning):

  ARIES (Mar. 21 - Apr. 19)
  This will be a wonderful week. You'll get some
  good news on Monday and you'll meet an
  interesting person at the weekend. Enjoy
  yourself!

  TAURUS (Apr. 20 - May 21)
  This won't be an easy week. You'll argue with
  someone at school, but don't worry — everything
  will be okay soon.

  GEMINI (May 22 - June 21)
  It will be a lucky week for you. You'll receive
  an invitation to a party on Friday. Accept it!

  CANCER (June 22 - July 22)
  This will be a busy week. There will be a lot of
  work, but you'll have a lot of fun at the
  weekend.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:

  QO'Y (21-mart — 19-aprel)
  Bu ajoyib hafta bo'ladi. Dushanba kuni yaxshi
  yangilik olasan va dam olish kunlari qiziqarli
  odam bilan uchrashasan. Zavqlan!

  BUZOQ (20-aprel — 21-may)
  Bu oson hafta bo'lmaydi. Maktabda kimdir bilan
  janjallashasan, lekin xavotir olma — tez orada
  hammasi yaxshi bo'ladi.

  EGIZAKLAR (22-may — 21-iyun)
  Bu sen uchun omadli hafta bo'ladi. Juma kuni
  ziyofatga taklif olasan. Uni qabul qil!

  QISQIChBAQA (22-iyun — 22-iyul)
  Bu band hafta bo'ladi. Ish ko'p bo'ladi, lekin
  dam olish kunlari juda ko'ngilli vaqt
  o'tkazasan.


GRAMMATIK QOIDALAR — ESLATMA:

  1) HAMMA bashorat 'WILL' bilan
     (95-bet: bashorat uchun 'will').

  2) 'IT will be + SIFAT' / 'THERE will be + OT'
     'It will be a lucky week.' (sifat: lucky)
     'There will be a lot of work.' (ot: work)

  3) 'You'll' = 'You will' (qisqargan shakl).

  4) INKOR: 'This WON'T be ...' (= will not).

  5) MASLAHAT — BUYRUQ gap:
     tasdiq: 'Accept it.' 'Enjoy yourself.'
     inkor:  'Don't worry.' 'Don't accept it.'


BEZASH:
  Kitob har bir burjning RASMINI chizishni
  so'raydi. Shu betdagi rasmlarga qarang:
  buqa (Taurus), egizaklar (Gemini),
  qisqichbaqa (Cancer), arslon (Leo),
  tarozi (Libra), chayon (Scorpio),
  baliqlar (Pisces), qo'y (Aries) va h.k.

sections.title: Writing — a letter to a friend about your plans

exercises.instructionEn: When we write a letter to a friend about our plans ...
exercises.instructionUz: Do'stga rejalarimiz haqida xat yozganimizda ...
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI QUTI:

  'When we write A LETTER TO A FRIEND ABOUT OUR
   PLANS, we divide the letter into FOUR
   PARAGRAPHS. We START with DEAR + OUR FRIEND'S
   FIRST NAME. In this type of letter we use
   BE GOING TO to talk about our plans/intentions
   and the PRESENT CONTINUOUS to talk about fixed
   future arrangements. To express REASON or
   PURPOSE, we use SO, BECAUSE or TO-INFINITIVE.
   We END the letter with LOVE/BEST WISHES/YOURS,
   + OUR FIRST NAME.'


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  Do'stga rejalarimiz haqida xat yozganimizda,
  xatni to'rt xatboshiga bo'lamiz. 'Dear +
  do'stimizning ismi' bilan boshlaymiz. Bunday
  xatda rejalar va niyatlar haqida gapirish uchun
  'be going to' ni, qat'iy belgilangan kelajak
  ishlari haqida gapirish uchun esa 'present
  continuous' ni ishlatamiz. Sabab yoki maqsadni
  ifodalash uchun 'so', 'because' yoki 'to +
  fe'l' dan foydalanamiz. Xatni 'Love / Best
  Wishes / Yours, + ismimiz' bilan tugatamiz.


⚠ KITOBDA KIChIK NOMUVOFIQLIK:
  Quti 'FOUR paragraphs' (to'rt xatboshi) deydi,
  lekin quyidagi 'Plan' BESH xatboshini
  ko'rsatadi (Para 1, 2, 3, 4, 5).
  Amalda PLAN ga amal qiling.


QUTIDAGI TO'RT QOIDA:

  1) BOShLANISh:
     'Dear + do'stning ISMI,'
     Masalan: 'Dear Sarah,'
     DIQQAT: faqat ISM (familiya emas),
     keyin VERGUL.

  2) GRAMMATIKA:
     BE GOING TO       →  rejalar va niyatlar
     PRESENT CONTINUOUS →  qat'iy belgilangan
                           ishlar
     (93-betdagi qoida)

  3) SABAB va MAQSAD:
     SO       →  natija
     BECAUSE  →  sabab
     TO + fe'l →  maqsad
     (95-betdagi qoida)

  4) TUGALLANMA:
     'Love,'         — eng yaqin do'st, qarindosh
     'Best Wishes,'  — do'st, tanish
     'Yours,'        — kamroq yaqin
     keyin ISMINGIZ.


93-BETDAGI JENNINING XATI — ANDOZA:
  Bu qoidalarning hammasi Jennining xatida
  ishlatilgan:
     'Dear Sarah,'                    (boshlanish)
     'we're GOING TO stay ...'        (reja)
     'We're LEAVING on 1st June.'     (belgilangan)
     '... BECAUSE I want to earn ...' (sabab)
     '... TO LOSE some weight.'       (maqsad)
     'Love, Jenny'                    (tugallanma)

exercises.instructionEn: Write a letter to a friend telling him/her about your plans and inviting him/her to your house for a special event. Use the plan below to help you, as well as the letter in Ex. 3.
exercises.instructionUz: Do'stingizga rejalaringiz haqida xat yozing va uni maxsus tadbir uchun uyingizga taklif qiling. Quyidagi rejadan hamda 3-mashqdagi xatdan foydalaning.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI PLAN (daftar shaklida):

  Dear + (your friend's first name,)

  INTRODUCTION
     Para 1:  reason for writing the letter
              (xat yozish sababi)
              ↓
  MAIN BODY
     Para 2, 3:  your plans & intentions with
                 reasons
                 (rejalar va niyatlar, sabablari
                  bilan)
              ↓
     Para 4:  your arrangements — invite him/her
              to your house for a special event
              (belgilangan ishlar — do'stni maxsus
               tadbirga taklif qilish)
              ↓
  CONCLUSION
     Para 5:  closing remarks (eg. See you soon.)
              (yakuniy so'zlar)

  Love,
  (your first name)


HAR XATBOShIDA QAYSI GRAMMATIKA:

  Para 1  →  xat yozish sababi
             (oddiy gaplar, 'I've got some news')
  Para 2,3 →  BE GOING TO + because/so/to-inf
             (rejalar va sabablari)
  Para 4  →  PRESENT CONTINUOUS + aniq sana
             (belgilangan ish) + TAKLIF
  Para 5  →  yakuniy so'zlar


TO'LIQ NAMUNA XAT:

                          12 Bogishamol Street
                          Tashkent
                          10 May, ...

  Dear Aziz,

  How are you? I've got some great news! The
  summer holidays start next week and I've got a
  lot of plans.

  First, I'm going to work at my uncle's shop
  because I want to earn some extra money. I'm
  also going to join a swimming club to get fit.

  In August I'm going to start an English course.
  I want to find a good job next year, so I need
  to speak English well.

  Oh, I nearly forgot! On 20th June we're having a
  big party at our house to celebrate my sister's
  wedding. Would you like to come? You're welcome
  to spend the night here.

  Well, that's all for now. Write soon and tell me
  about your plans. See you soon!

                          Love,
                          Sardor


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:

                          Bog'ishamol ko'chasi, 12
                          Toshkent
                          10-may, ...

  Hurmatli Aziz,

  Yaxshimisan? Menda ajoyib yangilik bor! Yozgi
  ta'til keyingi hafta boshlanadi va menda ko'p
  rejalar bor.

  Avvalo, amakimning do'konida ishlamoqchiman,
  chunki bir oz qo'shimcha pul topmoqchiman.
  Shuningdek, chiniqish uchun suzish klubiga a'zo
  bo'lmoqchiman.

  Avgustda ingliz tili kursini boshlamoqchiman.
  Keyingi yil yaxshi ish topmoqchiman, shuning
  uchun ingliz tilida yaxshi gapirishim kerak.

  Voy, sal bo'lmasa unutayozdim! 20-iyunda
  uyimizda opamning to'yini nishonlash uchun katta
  ziyofat qilamiz. Kelishni xohlaysanmi? Kechasi
  shu yerda qolsang ham mayli.

  Xo'sh, hozircha shu. Tezroq yoz va rejalaring
  haqida ayt. Tez orada ko'rishguncha!

                          Mehr bilan,
                          Sardor


GRAMMATIKA — NAMUNADA QAYERDA IShLATILGAN:

  BE GOING TO (rejalar, aniq sana YO'Q):
     'I'm GOING TO work at my uncle's shop'
     'I'm also GOING TO join a swimming club'
     'I'm GOING TO start an English course'

  PRESENT CONTINUOUS (belgilangan, ANIQ SANA):
     'On 20th June we're HAVING a big party'

  BECAUSE (sabab):
     '... because I want to earn some extra money'

  SO (natija):
     'I want to find a good job next year, SO I
      need to speak English well.'

  TO + fe'l (maqsad):
     '... TO GET fit'
     '... TO CELEBRATE my sister's wedding'

  TAKLIF:
     'WOULD YOU LIKE TO come?'
     (15-mashqdagi muloyim taklif qolipi)


DIQQAT — MANZIL VA SANA:
  Rasmiy bo'lmagan xatda ham manzil va sana
  O'NG YUQORIDA yoziladi (93-betdagi Jennining
  xatidagi kabi).


FOYDALI IBORALAR:
  How are you?               = Yaxshimisan?
  I've got some great news!  = Menda ajoyib
                               yangilik bor!
  First, ... Also, ... Finally, ...
                             = Avvalo ...
                               Shuningdek ...
                               Nihoyat ...
  Oh, I nearly forgot!       = Voy, sal bo'lmasa
                               unutayozdim!
  Would you like to come?    = Kelishni
                               xohlaysanmi?
  You're welcome to ...      = ... bo'lsang mayli
  That's all for now.        = Hozircha shu.
  Write soon.                = Tezroq yoz.
  See you soon!              = Tez orada
                               ko'rishguncha!

exercises.instructionEn: Tony is writing to another friend, Steve, to tell him about his holiday plans. Complete the letter using the information from Ex. 14. Say what his plans are and give the reasons.
exercises.instructionUz: Toni boshqa do'sti Stivga ta'til rejalari haqida xat yozyapti. 14-mashqdagi ma'lumotdan foydalanib xatni to'ldiring. Uning rejalarini ayting va sabablarini keltiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOB BERGAN BOShLANISh VA OXIR:

  Dear Steve,
     I'm writing to tell you about my holiday
  plans. I'm going to Australia!
     I'm leaving on 12th June. ...

  ...

     Well, that's all my news. I'll send you a
  postcard when I get to Australia.

                              Best wishes,
                              Tony


O'RTASINI 14-MAShQDAGI JADVALDAN to'ldirasiz.


TO'LIQ NAMUNA XAT:

  Dear Steve,

  I'm writing to tell you about my holiday plans.
  I'm going to Australia!

  I'm leaving on 12th June. I'm going there
  because I want to see my sister and her family.
  I'm going to stay there for two months because I
  want to travel around while I'm there.

  I'm going to visit Sydney to see the Opera
  House. I also want to visit Canberra, the
  capital city, so I'm going to hire a car.

  I'm going to take a boat out to the Great
  Barrier Reef to see all the colourful fish.
  Finally, I'm going to take my video camera
  because I want to show everyone what Australia
  is like when I get back.

  Well, that's all my news. I'll send you a
  postcard when I get to Australia.

                              Best wishes,
                              Tony


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:

  Hurmatli Stiv,

  Senga ta'til rejalarim haqida yozyapman.
  Avstraliyaga ketyapman!

  12-iyunda jo'nayman. U yerga boryapman, chunki
  opamni va uning oilasini ko'rmoqchiman. U yerda
  ikki oy turaman, chunki bo'lganimda atrofni
  aylanib chiqmoqchiman.

  Opera teatrini ko'rish uchun Sidneyga
  bormoqchiman. Shuningdek, poytaxt Kanberraga
  ham bormoqchiman, shuning uchun mashina ijaraga
  olaman.

  Rang-barang baliqlarni ko'rish uchun Katta
  to'siq rifiga qayiqda chiqmoqchiman. Nihoyat,
  videokamerani olib ketmoqchiman, chunki
  qaytganimda hammaga Avstraliya qanaqaligini
  ko'rsatmoqchiman.

  Xo'sh, yangiliklarim shu. Avstraliyaga
  yetganimda senga otkritka yuboraman.

                              Eng yaxshi tilaklar
                              bilan,
                              Toni


ENG MUHIM — UCh SABAB IFODASINI ARALAShTIRING:

  BECAUSE ishlatilgan joylar:
     '... because I want to see my sister ...'
     '... because I want to travel around ...'
     '... because I want to show everyone ...'

  SO ishlatilgan joy:
     'I also want to visit Canberra ..., SO I'm
      going to hire a car.'

  TO + fe'l ishlatilgan joylar:
     '... to visit Sydney TO SEE the Opera House.'
     '... to the Great Barrier Reef TO SEE all the
      colourful fish.'

  Uchala shaklni ham ishlatish — mashqning
  ASOSIY maqsadi.


XAT QOLIPI (Coursebook 97-bet, Writing qutisi):
  Boshi:  'Dear + ISM,'
  Oxiri:  'Best wishes,' + ISM

  'Best Wishes' — do'st va tanishga.
  'Love' — eng yaqin do'st va qarindoshga
  (93-betdagi Jennining xatida shunday edi).


DIQQAT — ZAMONLAR:
  'I'M LEAVING on 12th June.'
     → PRESENT CONTINUOUS + ANIQ SANA
       (belgilangan reja)
  'I'M GOING TO stay there for two months.'
     → BE GOING TO (reja, aniq sana yo'q)
  'I'LL send you a postcard.'
     → WILL (va'da, ayni damdagi qaror)

  Uchala kelajak shakli ham bitta xatda!


DIQQAT — 'WHEN I GET TO AUSTRALIA':
  'when' dan keyin PRESENT SIMPLE.
  'when I WILL get' XATO.
  Xatning oxirida kitob bergan gapda ham shunday.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a postcard = otkritka
  to get to  = ... ga yetib bormoq
  news       = yangilik (SANALMAYDIGAN)
  Best wishes = eng yaxshi tilaklar bilan

tasks.answer: Dear Steve, I'm writing to tell you about my holiday plans. I'm going to Australia!

I'm going to visit Sydney to see the Opera House. I also want to visit Canberra, the capital city, so I'm going to hire a car.

I'm going to take a boat out to the Great Barrier Reef to see all the colourful fish. Finally, I'm going to take my video camera because I want to show everyone what Australia is like when I get back.
Well, that's all my news. I'll send you a postcard when I get to Australia. Best wishes, Tony

exercises.instructionEn: Read these sentences. What do they mean?
exercises.instructionUz: Bu gaplarni o'qing. Ular nimani anglatadi?
exercises.explanationUz:
UCh MAQOL — HAMMASI VAQT va KELAJAK HAQIDA.


1)  TIME WILL TELL.
    = Vaqt ko'rsatadi.

    Bu — UNIT 13 NING NOMI.
    Ma'nosi: kelajakda nima bo'lishini hozir hech
    kim bilmaydi. Faqat VAQT o'tgach ma'lum
    bo'ladi.

    QAChON AYTILADI: kimdir kelajak haqida
    bahslashganda yoki aniq javob bo'lmaganda.
    'Will he be a good president? Time will tell.'

    O'ZBEKChA: 'Vaqt hammasini ko'rsatadi.'


2)  A CHANGE IS AS GOOD AS A REST.
    = O'zgarish dam olish chalik foydali.

    So'zma-so'z: 'O'zgarish dam kabi yaxshi.'

    Ma'nosi: har doim dam olish shart emas —
    ba'zan shunchaki BOShQA ish qilish ham
    kuch beradi.

    Masalan: darsdan charchaganingizda uxlash
    o'rniga sport bilan shug'ullansangiz,
    xuddi dam olgandek tetiklashasiz.

    GRAMMATIKA: 'AS ... AS' qolipi (Unit 12)!
    'as good as' — tenglik.

    O'ZBEKChA: 'Ish almashtirish — dam olish
    bilan barobar.'


3)  TOMORROW NEVER COMES.
    = Ertaga hech qachon kelmaydi.

    Ma'nosi: ishni doim 'ertaga qilaman' deb
    kechiktirsangiz, u hech qachon
    BAJARILMAYDI — chunki har kuni 'bugun'
    bo'ladi, 'ertaga' esa doim oldinda turadi.

    Bu — KEChIKTIRIShGA qarshi ogohlantirish.

    O'ZBEKChA: 'Bugungi ishni ertaga qo'yma.'


UCh MAQOLNING BOG'LIQLIGI:
  1-maqol — kelajak NOMA'LUM
  2-maqol — hozirgi kunni yaxshi o'tkazish
  3-maqol — ishni KEChIKTIRMASLIK

  Uchalasi ham VAQTGA MUNOSABAT haqida.


GRAMMATIK KUZATUV:
  1-maqolda 'WILL' — Unit 13 ning grammatikasi.
  2-maqolda 'AS ... AS' — Unit 12 ning
     grammatikasi.
  3-maqolda 'NEVER' + PRESENT SIMPLE —
     umumiy haqiqat.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a change = o'zgarish
  a rest   = dam olish
  never    = hech qachon

exercises.explanationUz:
O'N GAP — HAR BIRIDA BITTA XATO.

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  1  'The exit is UNDER your left.'  →  ON


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
   1  under        →  ON            (NAMUNA)
   2  fog          →  FOGGY
                      (yoki 'It' → 'THERE')
   3  at Saturday  →  ON Saturday
   4  oldest than  →  OLDER than
   5  played good  →  played WELL
   6  didn't painted →  didn't PAINT
   7  the Poland   →  POLAND ('the' olib tashlanadi)
   8  Could he played →  Could he PLAY
   9  some sugars  →  some SUGAR
  10  When         →  WHERE


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI (tuzatilgan holda):
   1  Chiqish chap tomoningizda.
   2  Ertaga tumanli bo'ladi.
   3  Biz shanba kuni kasalxonaga boramiz.
   4  Jon Ketrindan katta.
   5  Futbol jamoasi kecha yaxshi o'ynadi.
   6  Pablo Pikasso 'Mona Liza' ni chizmagan.
   7  Varshava — Polsha poytaxti.
   8  U besh yoshida pianino chala olarmidi?
   9  Qahvangizga shakar solaymi?
  10  Yangi xitoy restorani qayerda?


HAR BIR XATONING TURI:

   1  PREDLOG:  'ON your left/right'
      (yo'l ko'rsatish iborasi)
      Coursebook 90-bet, 3-mashqning 5-bandi ham
      shu.

   2  SIFAT/OT:  'It will be + SIFAT'
      'fog' — OT, shuning uchun:
         'It will be FOGGY.'    (sifat)
      yoki 'THERE will be fog.' (ot)
      IKKALASI HAM TO'G'RI.

   3  PREDLOG:  KUN bilan 'ON'
      'ON Saturday' ✓  ('at Saturday' XATO)
      Coursebook 90-bet qoidasi:
         AT + soat, ON + kun/sana, IN + oy/yil.

   4  QIYOSIY DARAJA:  'THAN' bor →
      qiyosiy daraja kerak.
      'oldEST' — orttirma → 'oldER'.
      Unit 12 qoidasi.

   5  SIFAT → RAVISh:  'played' FE'L →
      RAVISh kerak.
      good → WELL.
      Unit 11 qoidasi.

   6  PAST SIMPLE INKOR:  'didn't' dan keyin
      ASOSIY shakl.
      'didn't PAINT' ✓  ('didn't painted' XATO).

   7  ARTIKL:  mamlakat nomlari oldidan 'the'
      QO'YILMAYDI.
      'POLAND' ✓  ('the Poland' XATO).
      ISTISNOLAR: the USA, the UK,
      the Netherlands.

   8  'COULD' dan keyin ASOSIY shakl.
      'Could he PLAY' ✓  ('Could he played' XATO).
      Modal fe'llarning umumiy qoidasi.

   9  SANALMAYDIGAN OT:  'sugar' — sanalmaydigan.
      'some SUGAR' ✓  ('some sugars' XATO).

  10  SAVOL SO'ZI:  restoran JOY, vaqt emas.
      'WHERE is the new Chinese restaurant?' ✓
      'When' — vaqt so'raydi, bu yerda mos emas.


XATOLARNING GURUHLARI:
  PREDLOG:        1, 3
  SIFAT/OT/RAVISh: 2, 5, 9
  DARAJA:         4
  FE'L ShAKLI:     6, 8
  ARTIKL:         7
  SAVOL SO'ZI:    10


QAYSI UNITDAN:
   1  Unit 5-6 (yo'l ko'rsatish)
   2  Unit 13 (It/There will be)
   3  Unit 9-10 (vaqt predloglari)
   4  Unit 12 (qiyoslash)
   5  Unit 11 (ravishlar)
   6  Unit 9-11 (past simple)
   7  Unit 1-2 (mamlakatlar)
   8  Unit 9 (could)
   9  Unit 8 (sanaladigan/sanalmaydigan)
  10  Unit 1-3 (savol so'zlari)

exercises.instructionEn: Choose the correct item.
exercises.instructionUz: To'g'ri variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
O'N BIR BAND — 1-13 unitlarning UMUMIY TAKRORI.

BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
   1  C  and
   2  B  will
   3  A  Were
   4  C  in
   5  C  loaves
   6  B  much
   7  A  work
   8  B  than
   9  C  had
  10  B  Few
  11  C  could


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
   1  Piter pardalarni tortdi va derazadan qaradi.
   2  Sizningcha, ertaga tumanli bo'ladimi?
   3  Kecha kutubxonada edingizmi?
   4  O'sha kunlarda odamlarda vodoprovod suvi
      yo'q edi.
   5  Bizga qancha non kerak?
   6  Qancha shakar xohlaysiz?
   7  Antoni shu yerda ishlaydimi?
   8  U akasidan og'irroq.
   9  Bugun ertalab bir stakan sut ichdim.
  10  1950-yilda kam odamda televizor bor edi.
  11  U besh yoshida o'qiy olardi.


HAR BIRI QAYSI MAVZUNI TEKShIRADI:

   1  BOG'LOVChI: 'and' (ketma-ket ikki harakat)
      Piter avval pardani tortdi, KEYIN qaradi.
      'because' — sabab (mos emas),
      'when' — vaqt (mos emas).

   2  'DO YOU THINK it ...... be foggy?'
      Kelajak haqida TAXMIN → WILL.
      'don't' va 'can' mos emas.
      Unit 13.

   3  '...... you in the library YESTERDAY?'
      'you' + o'tgan zamon → WERE.
      'Was' — birlik uchun ('I', 'he', 'she',
      'it').
      'Wasn't' — inkor (savolda mos emas).

   4  'IN those days' — turg'un ibora
      (o'sha kunlarda).
      'on those days' / 'at those days' XATO.
      'running water' = vodoprovod suvi.

   5  'How MANY ...... of bread?'
      'many' → KO'PLIK ot kerak → LOAVES.
      'loaf' → 'LOAVES' (noto'g'ri ko'plik).
      'a loaf of bread' = bir non.
      Unit 8 (o'lchov iboralari).

   6  'How ...... SUGAR do you want?'
      'sugar' — SANALMAYDIGAN → HOW MUCH.
      'how many' — sanaladigan otlar bilan.
      Unit 8.

   7  'DOES Anthony ...... here?'
      'does' dan keyin ASOSIY shakl → WORK.
      'works' XATO ('-s' allaqachon 'does' da).
      Unit 5.

   8  'He is heavier ...... his brother.'
      'heavIER' — QIYOSIY daraja → THAN.
      Unit 12.

   9  'I ...... a glass of milk THIS MORNING.'
      'this morning' — o'tgan vaqt → PAST SIMPLE.
      have → HAD.
      'did' va 'have' mos emas.

  10  '...... people owned a television in 1950.'
      'people' — SANALADIGAN (ko'plik) → FEW.
      'little' — sanalmaydigan otlar bilan.
      'any' — so'roq/inkor gaplarda.
      'FEW people' = kam odam.

  11  'She ...... read WHEN SHE WAS FIVE.'
      'when she WAS five' — O'TGAN zamon →
      COULD.
      'can' — hozirgi zamon,
      'can't' — hozirgi inkor.
      Unit 9.


ENG ALDAMChI BANDLAR:

   5  'How many LOAVES of bread' —
      'bread' sanalmaydigan, lekin 'loaf'
      SANALADIGAN. Shuning uchun 'how MANY'.
      Ko'plik: loaf → LOAVES ('f' → 'ves').

   6  'How much SUGAR' —
      5-band bilan SOLIShTIRING: u yerda 'many'
      (loaves — sanaladigan), bu yerda 'much'
      (sugar — sanalmaydigan).

  10  'FEW people' —
      'few' SANALADIGAN, 'little' SANALMAYDIGAN.
      'people' — sanaladigan ko'plik → FEW.


NOTO'G'RI KO'PLIKLAR:
     loaf   →  LOAVES
     knife  →  KNIVES
     leaf   →  LEAVES
     wife   →  WIVES
     life   →  LIVES
  ('-f' yoki '-fe' → '-VES')

sentencePatterns.formula: ega + AM/IS/ARE + GOING TO + ASOSIY fe'l.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Jenny is going to stay at a fabulous hotel.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Jenni ajoyib mehmonxonada turmoqchi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'BE GOING TO' — oldindan o'ylangan REJA va NIYAT.
'going to' dan keyin fe'lning ASOSIY shakli.

sentencePatterns.formula: ega + ISN'T/AREN'T + GOING TO + ASOSIY fe'l.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Jenny isn't going to sunbathe.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Jenni quyoshda toblanmoqchi emas.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
INKOR: 'not' 'be' fe'lidan KEYIN qo'yiladi.
'is not going to' → 'isn't going to'.

sentencePatterns.formula: ega + AM/IS/ARE + fe'l-ING + ON + sana.   (aniq reja)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Jenny is having a party on 16th August.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Jenni 16-avgustda ziyofat qiladi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
PRESENT CONTINUOUS — ANIQ SANAGA belgilangan
kelajak rejasi.
SANA bilan 'ON' predlogi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Where is X going to spend her holiday?  —  She is going to spend it in ... .
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Where is Jenny going to spend her summer holiday?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Jenni yozgi ta'tilini qayerda o'tkazmoqchi?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Savoldagi zamon javobda SAQLANADI.
'spend a holiday' = ta'tilni o'tkazmoq.

sentencePatterns.formula: START + fe'l-ING   /   START + OT
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: start windsurfing / start French lessons / start a computer course
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: vindserfingni boshlamoq / fransuz tili darslarini boshlamoq / kompyuter kursini boshlamoq
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'start' dan keyin FE'L kelsa — '-ING' oladi.
OT kelsa — o'zgarmaydi.

sentencePatterns.formula: ega + AM/IS/ARE (NOT) + GOING TO + ASOSIY fe'l.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I'm going to listen to music and relax. I'm not going to fly to New Delhi.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Musiqa tinglab dam olmoqchiman. Nyu-Delhiga uchmoqchi emasman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
REJA va NIYAT.
'not' 'be' fe'lidan KEYIN.
'do/does' KERAK EMAS.

sentencePatterns.formula: AM/IS/ARE + ega + GOING TO + ASOSIY fe'l?  —  Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Are you going to move house? — Yes, I am.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Boshqa uyga ko'chib o'tmoqchimisan? — Ha.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
So'roqda 'be' OLDINGA chiqadi.
Qisqa javobda 'going to' TAKRORLANMAYDI.

sentencePatterns.formula: ega + AM/IS/ARE + fe'l-ING + [ANIQ VAQT].   (qat'iy belgilangan)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: We're leaving on 1st June. I'm flying to Poland at 7 o'clock.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Biz 1-iyunda jo'naymiz. Soat yettida Polshaga uchaman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
PRESENT CONTINUOUS — ANIQ VAQT bo'lganda.
Chipta olingan, sana kelishilgan.

sentencePatterns.formula: ega + is going to + fe'l + BECAUSE + [ega + fe'l].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: They are going to stay at a hotel because they both love swimming.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ular mehmonxonada turmoqchi, chunki ikkalasi ham suzishni yaxshi ko'radi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'because' — SABAB.
Ergash gapda EGA va FE'L bo'ladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: ega + is going to + fe'l + TO + ASOSIY fe'l.   (MAQSAD)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She is going to join a gym to lose some weight.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U vazn tashlash uchun sport zaliga a'zo bo'lmoqchi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'to + fe'l' — MAQSAD ('nima uchun?').
Ergash gapda ega YO'Q.

sentencePatterns.formula: What IS + ega + DOING at [soat]?  —  ega + 'S + fe'l-ING at [soat].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What is Tom doing at ten o'clock? — He's visiting the dentist at ten o'clock.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Tom soat o'nda nima qiladi? — Soat o'nda tish shifokoriga boradi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Kundalikka yozilgan, ANIQ SOATI bor ish →
PRESENT CONTINUOUS.

sentencePatterns.formula: [DALIL]. ega + is/are GOING TO + ASOSIY fe'l.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: There are dark clouds in the sky. It's going to rain.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Osmonda qora bulutlar bor. Yomg'ir yog'adi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
HOZIRGI DALILGA asoslangan bashorat.
Avval dalil, keyin bashorat.

sentencePatterns.formula: What's she GOING TO do?  ↔  What's she DOING?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What's she going to do? — She's going to wash the car. / What's she doing? — She's washing the car.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U nima qilmoqchi? — Mashinani yuvmoqchi. / U nima qilyapti? — Mashinani yuvyapti.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Harakat hali boshlanmagan → 'going to'.
Hozir sodir bo'lmoqda → present continuous.
SAVOL ham shunga qarab o'zgaradi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Is she + fe'l-ING ?  —  No, she isn't. She's GOING TO + ASOSIY fe'l.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Is she washing the car? — No, she isn't. She's going to wash the car.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U mashinani yuvyaptimi? — Yo'q. U mashinani yuvmoqchi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Qisqa javob + TUZATISH.
'be' fe'li bilan — 'do' KERAK EMAS.

sentencePatterns.formula: A BECAUSE B.  /  B, SO A.  /  A TO + fe'l.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Tony is going to save money because he wants to go on holiday. / Tony wants to go on holiday, so he is going to save money. / Tony is going to save money to go on holiday.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Toni pul yig'moqchi, chunki ta'tilga bormoqchi. / Toni ta'tilga bormoqchi, shuning uchun pul yig'moqchi. / Toni ta'tilga borish uchun pul yig'moqchi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Bir fikrni UCH xil aytish.
'because' va 'so' da TARTIB TESKARI.
'to + fe'l' — eng qisqa shakl.

sentencePatterns.formula: [HOZIRGI HOLAT]. I'LL + ASOSIY fe'l.   (shu payt qabul qilingan qaror)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I'm cold. I'll close the window. I'm thirsty. I'll have a glass of water.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Sovqotdim. Derazani yopaman. Chanqadim. Bir stakan suv ichaman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Avval HOLAT (sabab), keyin QAROR.
Qaror AYNI DAMDA qabul qilingan.

sentencePatterns.formula: In [vaqt], there WILL BE + ot.   (bashorat)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: In 100 years' time, there will be underwater cities.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: 100 yildan keyin suv ostida shaharlar bo'ladi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Uzoq kelajak haqidagi BASHORAT.
Dalil yo'q — shunchaki fikr.

sentencePatterns.formula: IT will be + SIFAT.   /   THERE will be + OT.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It will be rainy tomorrow. There will be rain tomorrow.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ertaga yomg'irli bo'ladi. Ertaga yomg'ir bo'ladi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
SIFAT → IT, OT → THERE.
Ma'no BIR XIL, faqat shakl boshqa.
ENG SODDA IP: '-y' bilan tugasa — sifat.

sentencePatterns.formula: WILL IT BE + sifat + in [joy] tomorrow?  —  Yes, it will. / No, it won't.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Will it be sunny in Bangkok tomorrow? — Yes, it will.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ertaga Bangkokda quyoshli bo'ladimi? — Ha.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
So'roqda 'WILL' OLDINGA chiqadi.
Qisqa javobda 'be' TAKRORLANMAYDI.
'won't' = 'will not'.

sentencePatterns.formula: This WILL BE a(n) [sifat] week.   /   This WON'T BE a good week.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: This will be an exciting week. This won't be a good week for you.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu qiziqarli hafta bo'ladi. Bu sen uchun yaxshi hafta bo'lmaydi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Bashoratning ochilish gapi.
'won't' = 'will not'.
Unli tovushdan oldin 'an'.

sentencePatterns.formula: You'LL + ASOSIY fe'l + ... + ON [kun] / AT the weekend.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: You'll receive a letter from a friend. You'll get an invitation at the weekend.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Do'stingdan xat olasan. Dam olish kunlari taklif olasan.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'You'll' = 'You will'.
KUN bilan 'ON', 'weekend' bilan 'AT'.

sentencePatterns.formula: THERE WILL BE + OT.   /   IT WILL BE + SIFAT.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: There will be bad news on Wednesday. It will be a pleasant week for you.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Chorshanba kuni yomon yangilik bo'ladi. Bu sen uchun yoqimli hafta bo'ladi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
95-betdagi qoida bashoratlarda ISTISNOSIZ
ishlaydi: OT → THERE, SIFAT → IT.

sentencePatterns.formula: [Salbiy bashorat]. DON'T WORRY — everything will be okay soon.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: You'll argue with your best friend. Don't worry — you'll soon be friends again.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Eng yaqin do'sting bilan janjallashasan. Xavotir olma — tez orada yana do'st bo'lasizlar.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Salbiy bashoratdan keyin DOIM TASALLI beriladi.
Gemini, Virgo, Sagittarius va Pisces
bashoratlarida shunday.

sentencePatterns.formula: What's your star sign?  —  I'm a/an [burj].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What's your star sign? — I'm an Aquarius.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Burjing qaysi? — Men Qovgaman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Unli tovush bilan boshlansa — 'an'
(an Aquarius, an Aries).
Undosh bilan — 'a' (a Leo, a Taurus).

sentencePatterns.formula: THERE WILL BE + OT.   /   THERE WON'T BE ENOUGH + OT.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: There will be more people in the world. There won't be enough trees.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Dunyoda odamlar ko'proq bo'ladi. Yetarlicha daraxt bo'lmaydi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
OT bilan 'THERE will be'.
'enough' OT dan OLDIN turadi.
'won't' = 'will not'.

sentencePatterns.formula: Do you want to / WOULD YOU LIKE TO come with me?  —  I'd love to.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Would you like to come with me? — I'd love to.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Men bilan kelishni xohlaysizmi? — Bajonidil.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
TAKLIF QILISH va QABUL QILISH.
'Would you like to' — muloyimroq.
'I'd love to' — 'to' dan keyin fe'l
takrorlanmaydi.

sentencePatterns.formula: I'd love to, BUT I CAN'T. [SABAB].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I'd love to, but I can't. I'm going to the cinema with Bob.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Juda xohlardim, lekin bora olmayman. Bob bilan kinoga boryapman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
MULOYIM RAD ETISH — uch qism:
xohlash + imkonsizlik + SABAB.
Faqat 'No' deyish QO'POL hisoblanadi.

sentencePatterns.formula: On [ANIQ SANA] we're [fe'l-ING] ... TO CELEBRATE ... . Would you like to come?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: On 20th June we're having a big party at our house to celebrate my sister's wedding. Would you like to come?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: 20-iyunda uyimizda opamning to'yini nishonlash uchun katta ziyofat qilamiz. Kelishni xohlaysanmi?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
PRESENT CONTINUOUS + ANIQ SANA (belgilangan ish)
+ 'to celebrate' (maqsad) + TAKLIF.
Xatning 4-xatboshisi uchun qolip.

sentencePatterns.formula: an hour / an honest man   ↔   a hand / a horrible week
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It will take an hour. He is an honest man. Give me a hand.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu bir soat oladi. U halol odam. Menga yordam ber.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Artikl HARFGA emas, TOVUSHGA qaraydi.
'h' o'qilmasa → AN, o'qilsa → A.

sentencePatterns.formula: ega + AM/IS/ARE + GOING TO + ASOSIY fe'l.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He is going to visit his friends. I am going to start a computer course.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U do'stlarinikiga bormoqchi. Kompyuter kursini boshlamoqchiman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
REJA va NIYAT.
'be' fe'li ega bo'yicha o'zgaradi,
'going to' o'zgarmaydi.

sentencePatterns.formula: AM/IS/ARE + ega + GOING TO + ASOSIY fe'l?  —  Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Is he going to visit his friends? — Yes, he is.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U do'stlarinikiga bormoqchimi? — Ha.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
So'roqda 'be' OLDINGA chiqadi.
Qisqa javobda 'going to' takrorlanmaydi.

sentencePatterns.formula: [DALIL]. ega + is/are GOING TO + ASOSIY fe'l.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: There are dark clouds in the sky. It's going to rain.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Osmonda qora bulutlar bor. Yomg'ir yog'adi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
HOZIRGI DALILGA asoslangan bashorat.
Avval dalil, keyin bashorat.

sentencePatterns.formula: ega + WILL + ASOSIY fe'l.   /   ega + WON'T + ASOSIY fe'l.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He will go to the park. They won't buy a new house.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U parkka boradi. Ular yangi uy sotib olishmaydi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'will' hamma shaxs uchun BIR XIL.
Fe'l ASOSIY shaklda ('-s' yo'q).

sentencePatterns.formula: WILL + ega + ASOSIY fe'l?  —  Yes, I will. / No, I won't.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Will he go to the park? — Yes, he will.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U parkka boradimi? — Ha.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'will' OLDINGA chiqadi.
'do/does/did' KERAK EMAS.

sentencePatterns.formula: They'RE + fe'l-ING + ... + ON + [kun].   (belgilangan ish)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: They're going to the cinema on Monday. They're having a dinner party on Saturday.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Dushanba kuni kinoga borishadi. Shanba kuni kechki ziyofat qilishadi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Kundalikka yozilgan, ANIQ KUNI bor ish →
PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
KUN bilan 'ON' predlogi.

sentencePatterns.formula: [MUAMMO]. I'LL + ASOSIY fe'l.   (ayni damdagi qaror)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It's hot in here. — I'll open the window. The phone is ringing. — I'll answer it.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu yerda issiq. — Derazani ochaman. Telefon jiringlayapti. — Javob beraman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
A muammoni aytadi, B AYNI DAMDA yordam
taklif qiladi → WILL.

sentencePatterns.formula: I KNOW. I'M GOING TO + ASOSIY fe'l.   (allaqachon reja)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Your shirt is dirty. — I know. I'm going to wash it later.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ko'ylagingiz iflos. — Bilaman. Keyinroq yuvaman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'I know' — allaqachon bilgan va rejalashtirgan
→ BE GOING TO ('will' XATO bo'lardi).

sentencePatterns.formula: IT WILL BE + SIFAT.   /   THERE WILL BE + OT.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It will be foggy tomorrow. There will be fog tomorrow.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ertaga tumanli bo'ladi. Ertaga tuman bo'ladi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
SIFAT → IT, OT → THERE.
Ma'no BIR XIL, faqat shakl boshqa.

sentencePatterns.formula: A BECAUSE B.  /  B, SO A.  /  A TO + fe'l.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She's going to save money because she wants to go on holiday. / She wants to go on holiday, so she's going to save money. / She's going to save money to go on holiday.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U pul yig'moqchi, chunki ta'tilga bormoqchi. / U ta'tilga bormoqchi, shuning uchun pul yig'moqchi. / U ta'tilga borish uchun pul yig'moqchi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
SABAB / NATIJA / MAQSAD.
'because' va 'so' da tartib TESKARI.
'to + fe'l' — eng qisqa shakl.

sentencePatterns.formula: [HOZIRGI DALIL]. ega + is/am/are GOING TO + ASOSIY fe'l.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Robert is on a diet. He is going to lose weight. Peter is still in bed. He is going to be late for school.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Robert parhezda. U vazn tashlamoqchi. Piter hali ham karavotda. U maktabga kechikadi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Avval DALIL, keyin natija.
DIQQAT: oxirgi misolda bu REJA emas —
DALILGA asoslangan BASHORAT.

sentencePatterns.formula: I'LL HAVE + [taom], please.   (restoranda buyurtma)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Are you ready to order, sir? — Yes, I'll have the steak, please.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Buyurtma berishga tayyormisiz, janob? — Ha, bifshteks olaman, iltimos.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Restoranda buyurtma berishda DOIM
'I'll have ...' — turg'un ibora.

sentencePatterns.formula: ega + is/am/are + fe'l-ING + [ANIQ VAQT].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: They are having dinner at Mario's on Saturday evening. I am flying to Madrid next month.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ular shanba kechqurun 'Mario's' da kechki ovqat qilishadi. Keyingi oy Madridga uchaman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
ANIQ VAQT bo'lsa → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
Harakat fe'llari (fly, go, come, leave) bilan
ayniqsa ko'p.

sentencePatterns.formula: I'M SURE + ega + WILL + ASOSIY fe'l.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I'm sure Kelly will let you borrow her CDs.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ishonchim komilki, Kelli senga o'z disklarini beradi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'I'm sure' — FIKR, dalil yo'q → WILL.
DIQQAT: 'let sb DO sth' — 'to' YO'Q.

sentencePatterns.formula: She'S GOING TO + ASOSIY fe'l + ... .   (ziyofat rejalari)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She's going to send invitations to her friends. She's going to hire a band.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U do'stlariga taklifnoma yubormoqchi. U musiqa guruhini yollamoqchi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: REJA va NIYAT — aniq vaqt YO'Q.

sentencePatterns.formula: THERE WILL BE + OT.   /   IT WILL BE + SIFAT.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: There will be fewer cars in the future. It will be foggy in London tomorrow.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kelajakda mashinalar kamroq bo'ladi. Ertaga Londonda tumanli bo'ladi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
OT → THERE, SIFAT → IT.
FEWER + sanaladigan, LESS + sanalmaydigan.

sentencePatterns.formula: [SABAB], SO + ega + IS GOING TO + ASOSIY fe'l.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Tom has toothache, so he is going to visit the dentist.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Tomning tishi og'riyapti, shuning uchun u tish shifokoriga bormoqchi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'so' — NATIJA bog'lovchisi.
'so' dan OLDIN VERGUL.

sentencePatterns.formula: ega + IS GOING TO + fe'l + BECAUSE + ega + WANTS TO + fe'l.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Cindy is going to save money because she wants to buy a car.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Sindi pul yig'moqchi, chunki mashina sotib olmoqchi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'because' — SABAB.
Ergash gapda EGA va FE'L bor.

sentencePatterns.formula: How MANY + KO'PLIK ot ?   /   How MUCH + SANALMAYDIGAN ot ?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: How many loaves of bread do we need? How much sugar do you want?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bizga qancha non kerak? Qancha shakar xohlaysiz?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
SANALADIGAN → many,
SANALMAYDIGAN → much.

sentencePatterns.formula: ega + COULD + ASOSIY fe'l + when + ega + WAS ... .
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She could read when she was five.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U besh yoshida o'qiy olardi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
O'TGAN zamondagi QOBILIYAT → COULD.
'could' dan keyin ASOSIY shakl.

sentencePatterns.formula: ega + IS/ARE GOING TO + ASOSIY fe'l + ... .
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She's going to pick some flowers. They're going to have a picnic in the park.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U gul termoqchi. Ular parkda piknik qilishmoqchi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
REJA va NIYAT.
Olmoshni to'g'ri tanlang: bir kishi → he's/she's,
ikki kishi → they're.

sentencePatterns.formula: [SABAB], SO + ega + IS GOING TO + ASOSIY fe'l.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Joe doesn't like working at the cafe, so he is going to find another job.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Joga kafedagi ish yoqmaydi, shuning uchun u boshqa ish topmoqchi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'so' — NATIJA bog'lovchisi.
'so' dan OLDIN VERGUL.

sentencePatterns.formula: She'S GOING TO buy SOME + ot.   /   She ISN'T GOING TO buy ANY + ot.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She's going to buy some onions. She isn't going to buy any biscuits.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U piyoz sotib olmoqchi. U pechenye sotib olmoqchi emas.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
TASDIQ → SOME, INKOR → ANY.
'not' 'be' fe'lidan KEYIN ('isn't').

sentencePatterns.formula: [Ism], you WILL + fe'l ... . You will ALSO + fe'l ... .
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Andy, you will argue with your best friend. You will also have problems with your car.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Endi, sen eng yaqin do'sting bilan janjallashasan. Shuningdek, mashinang bilan muammoing bo'ladi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Munajjim BASHORAT qilyapti → 'WILL'.
'also' — 'will' dan KEYIN, fe'ldan OLDIN.

sentencePatterns.formula: [savol so'zi] + ARE + you + fe'l-ING + ... + [predlog]?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Where are you going? Who are you going with? How long are you going for?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Qayerga ketyapsan? Kim bilan ketyapsan? Qancha vaqtga ketyapsan?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
BELGILANGAN reja haqida savol →
PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
Predlog gap OXIRIDA qoladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: [HOZIRGI DALIL]. ega + IS/ARE GOING TO + ASOSIY fe'l.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She can't stop the car! She is going to crash. Mum's looking at a recipe. She is going to make a cake.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U mashinani to'xtata olmayapti! U urilib ketadi. Oyim retseptga qarayapti. U tort pishirmoqchi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Avval DALIL, keyin natija.
BASHORAT (xohlamaydi) yoki NIYAT (o'zi hal
qilgan) — ikkalasi ham 'be going to' bilan.

sentencePatterns.formula: They'RE GOING TO + ASOSIY fe'l + ... .   (reja, sana YO'Q)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: They're going to order a wedding cake. They're going to hire a photographer.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ular to'y torti buyurtma qilishmoqchi. Ular fotograf yollashmoqchi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: REJA — aniq vaqt hali belgilanmagan.

sentencePatterns.formula: They'RE + fe'l-ING + ... + ON + [kun].   (belgilangan ish)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: They're taking the dog to the vet's on Monday. They're driving to the beach on Saturday.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Dushanba kuni itni veterinarga olib borishadi. Shanba kuni plyajga haydab borishadi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Kundalikka yozilgan, ANIQ KUNI bor →
PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
KUN bilan 'ON'.

sentencePatterns.formula: [HOLAT]. I'LL + ASOSIY fe'l + ... .
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I'm cold. I'll put a jumper on. The car isn't working. I'll call a mechanic.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Sovqotdim. Sviter kiyaman. Mashina ishlamayapti. Ustani chaqiraman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
AYNI DAMDA qabul qilingan qaror → WILL.
Avval holat, keyin qaror.

sentencePatterns.formula: WHEN I + PRESENT SIMPLE, I'M GOING TO + ASOSIY fe'l.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: When I retire I'm going to travel around the world. When I get my degree I'm going to learn to drive.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Nafaqaga chiqqanimda dunyo bo'ylab sayohat qilaman. Diplomimni olganimda mashina haydashni o'rganaman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'when' dan keyin KELASI zamon ISHLATILMAYDI —
PRESENT SIMPLE qo'yiladi.
'When I will retire' XATO.

sentencePatterns.formula: 'Why ...?'  —  ega + IS/ARE GOING TO + fe'l.   (holatni tushuntirish)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Why is Karen wearing her trainers? — She's going to play tennis with Ray.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Nega Karen krossovka kiygan? — U Rey bilan tennis o'ynamoqchi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'Why ...?' savoliga javob HOZIRGI HOLATNI
tushuntiradi → reja ALLAQACHON bor →
BE GOING TO.

sentencePatterns.formula: He's going to take [narsa] TO [maqsad] / BECAUSE he wants to [maqsad].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He's going to take a camera to take pictures. He's going to take a camera because he wants to take pictures.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Surat olish uchun fotoapparat olib ketmoqchi. Fotoapparat olib ketmoqchi, chunki surat olmoqchi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'to + fe'l' — MAQSAD (ega yo'q).
'because' — SABAB (ega va fe'l bor).

sentencePatterns.formula: He wants to [maqsad], SO he's going to take [narsa].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He wants to catch some fish, so he's going to take a fishing rod.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U baliq tutmoqchi, shuning uchun qarmoq olib ketmoqchi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'so' — NATIJA.
Tartib 'because' ga nisbatan TESKARI.

sentencePatterns.formula: Do you want to come?  —  Yes, please. I'd love to.  /  I'm sorry, but I can't.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Do you want to join us? — Yes, please. I'd love to.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bizga qo'shilishni xohlaysanmi? — Ha, iltimos. Bajonidil.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
QABUL QILISH: 'I'D love to' ('would' SHART).
RAD ETISH: uzr + imkonsizlik.
Faqat 'No' — QO'POL.

sentencePatterns.formula: I'm going to [reja] BECAUSE I want to [sabab].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I'm going there because I want to see my sister and her family.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U yerga boryapman, chunki opamni va uning oilasini ko'rmoqchiman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
BECAUSE — SABAB.
Ergash gapda EGA va FE'L bor.

sentencePatterns.formula: I want to [maqsad], SO I'm going to [reja].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I also want to visit Canberra, so I'm going to hire a car.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kanberraga ham bormoqchiman, shuning uchun mashina ijaraga olaman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
SO — NATIJA.
Tartib 'because' ga nisbatan TESKARI.

sentencePatterns.formula: I'm going to [reja] TO [maqsad].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I'm going to visit Sydney to see the Opera House.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Opera teatrini ko'rish uchun Sidneyga bormoqchiman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
TO + fe'l — MAQSAD.
Ega YO'Q, eng qisqa shakl.

sentencePatterns.formula: I'll send you a postcard WHEN I GET to Australia.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I'll send you a postcard when I get to Australia.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Avstraliyaga yetganimda senga otkritka yuboraman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'when' dan keyin PRESENT SIMPLE.
'when I will get' XATO.
Asosiy gapda esa 'will'.
